Wonderful location, very helpful and responsive hosts! Thank you, Beatriz, for your flexibility and help! Appreciated the morning treats and early check-in! Lovely apartment!
Perfect place to stay! Everything looked just like the pictures, was very clean, and in a great location. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend.

The apartment is perfect for two people. It's small but gives you everything that you need. The location very close to the metro stations and the large train station is great for getting around. It is also only 20-30 minutes from the airport with a taxi. The check-in process was very easy to understand.

We had a great time staying at Tobias’s apartment. The location is extremely central which is amazing. If you are easily disturbed by noise the center is pretty loud with lots of bars so I’d advice to pick a different place. The terrace was clearly a highlight with great tapas evenings enjoying the views and sunset.
great place to stay, Tobias is very friendly and helpful. it's near Gran Via (main street) where you can find restaurants and everything. Five Guys is 8 minutes away
Tobias was a fab host. went above and beyond to help us with our needs for our stay. Great central location for walks and to metro lines to all the tourist attractions. Thanks Tobias!

The accommodation was excellent, it was in a great location and about 10 minutes from Retiro Park which is a must to visit. There are restaurants, cafes and shops nearby and handy for the subway. The flat is on the 2nd floor but there is a lift. It was quiet and felt safe. The accommodation was a home from home and the host provided all you need to start off your visit. We had a warm welcome from Maria and she explained how everything worked. I’ve stayed in lots of four/five hotels but this was even better. When I’m back in Madrid I will book this accommodation, it was clean and fresh looking and air conditioning in all rooms. I was staying with my wife and older daughter and we all agreed it helped make our stay in Madrid great. Deserves to be a super host.

Carlos is a great host and the apartment couldn’t be better! It was really well decorated, full of details, spectacular location and 2 comfortable bedrooms and 2 cozy bathrooms. Thanks Carlos for everything! We enjoy our stay a lot.
Great host. Great location near Parc Retiro in a good neighborhood. If we return to Madrid 100% chance we stay at this apartment!

We feel so lucky to have found Carlos and his home. This is the 2nd time our family has stayed with him. We feel like Carlos’ home is our home in Madrid. We have two kids under 10 and we feel so safe and well taken care of that we won’t stay anywhere else when we visit Madrid. You simply can’t ask for a more thorough and sincere host, and such a well appointed, comfortable and clean apartment. Thank you so much Carlos, can’t wait to be back!!

I rarely rave in these reviews, but Carlos is another level. I have never stayed anywhere that’s been so meticulous, caring and generous in every way. The apartment itself is lovely, well appointed and amazing attention to all details. The place was stocked with everything I could ever imagine! From every type of milk and alternative, every nespresso capsule you could want, food for us to eat, even a nice bottle of wine to greet us and gifts for my daughters (who were not even staying with us!). 5 star hotels rarely are as generous and thoughtful as Carlos. Anything I can say about this apartment, location, etc is only secondary to the amazing host!

This is a beautiful apartment and looks exactly like it does in the photos! Check in was super easy. The friendly lady who met us there showed us around and explained everything. A Mercadona is about 5 minutes walk away. Around 20 mins to the nearest metro station into the city, but it's a lovely walk! Would recommend an eye mask if you're sleeping on the sofa bed, as the sun peaks through the blinds. Overall, the area is very peaceful and chill, will definitely return!

In the middle of everything. Such a nice experience for my first stay in Madrid!! Apartment is 2 blocks away from Puerta del Sol and 1/2 block from Gran Via. Walking distance to most attractions. I didn't meet Pablo, but he always responded to all of my needs, gently and quickly. Patricia, helped providing early check in accommodation for an extra guest. I strongly recommend this apt for either a couple or a family up to 4 people. Gracias chicos por la atencion, nos vemos pronto! Luis, Alberto & Lucas!!!

Modern clean apartment in the centre of town, 2 minutes walk from Callao. Central, busy bustling city centre right outside your door! Apartment itself is comfortable with everything you need, had a lift, safe and secure. Nice bathroom with shower. Easy to get around using Metro. We did a trip to Segovia & Àvila which I'd highly recommend, a nice day out. We used Express Tours, €40. Lots of souvenir shops offering their trips. For the best churros, visit San Ginés, 5 minute walk from apartment. Also Mercado de San Miguel for an amazing selection of tapas.
The place is great! The shower and the bed were comfortable. Just in front of the subway and train station! I would stay there again!
We really enjoyed Cristina’s place. Very close to the train station and Metro and a small store right next door. Would stay there again

The apartment is truly one of a kind. Super stylish, and extremely clean. The location is perfect and pretty much close to everything. We loved the energy around the location. Overall, we were very happy with our stay and we would love to stay here again if we came back to Madrid. Christina was extremely accommodating and friendly. Very quick responses. Christina was an amazing host.

Very nice house, clean and tidy. It is only a few steps from the station.Luggage can be stored in the station, which is very convenient.The location is very good and you can walk to all the attractions. The host was very kind and answered us promptly.

The room was exactly as described and as shown in the pictures. Compact, so clean, so comfortable and so conveniently located. We walked everywhere from the apartment. The high ceilings give great feeling of space. Lovely, luxurious towels. Great communications and the host kindly allowed us to store our cases after checkout time until we needed to catch the train.
Good experience with Cristina, she was really reactive. The apartment was really clean and well located, not far from the center of Madrid. Thank you, Cristina!
Everything we needed - great location near to museums and Atocha Train station. Stylishly done and sparkling clean. The air con was our saviour in Madrid Summer heat!

A modern, sleek, and stylish apartment close to the Museums in Madrid and the Atocha train station. The bed is up on a loft and very comfortable. The bathroom has unique and nice features, I loved the shower! Overall, a nice place to stay if you are in Madrid for a few days.

This loft is as beautiful and clean as it shows in picture. The building feels very safe, is surrounded by convenient and friendly little shops and is very close to Museo de Reina Sofía and Parque del Retiro. The actual living space inside is much smaller than expected. There’s practically no space to be shared, so I recommend it for one guest, and one who has no issues climbing up steep stairs to go to bed, and one who is not bothered by light filtering through windows at night. All in all, very charming.
A beautiful and comfortable home and a location very close to Retiro! We had a wonderful time at Christina's!
There is not much to say, since the apartment is simply amazing. It is really small, but beautifully furnished and perfect for a couple!!! I can only recommend it.

Jolly and Christina are amazing hosts! Their place was impeccable and the communication superb at all times. The location can't be any better if you're traveling by bus, train or rental car. Small and cozy, but with everything you may need. Thanks for an awesome place to stay!
Very nice apartment located in the center of madrid, Jolly was so nice and fixed every problem that we had. We felt very comfortable in this cozy and little Apartment :)

Incredibly chic, brand new, perfect location to access many things. We were surprised by how tiny the space really is but it is fine for an overnight stay before catching an early train or as home base for Madrid adventures outside of the loft. Best for those packing lightly. If you have more than 2 small cases you'll be tripping over your things.
Very good host, who was flexible with us and had great communication. Nice area, very close to the train station. Spotlessly clean and had everything you need.
Stylish, comfortable loft very conveniently located within walking distance to many sights in Madrid. We had a great stay and would recommend this airbnb.

Great location, super clean. Didn't need any assistance from the host for the duration of my stay, but I have absolutely no doubt help would've arrived immediately if I had. Recommended. Just pay attention when you're shown how to unlock the doors! 🤪
Perfect location for a short stay in Madrid! Apartment was clean and had everything you need, friendly host who give a very friendly welcome. No bad words to say, highly recommend! Thank you! :)

This is the second time we stayed at one of Christina’s spaces - though we loved the more spacious other room she had more, this one was also spotless, with an excellent bathroom, comfortable bed, and in the best most convenient location. Kudos to her for using every centimeter of available space so thoughtfully!

I really enjoyed my stay at this lovely loft! The place is very quiet, which made it perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring the city. The location is excellent — close to all the main attractions, so I could easily walk around and discover everything nearby. The apartment is clean, well-equipped, and the host provided clear and helpful instructions. I would definitely stay here again!
Ana was great — very accommodating and helpful. This is in a fun little area with access to lots of food and historical sights. Metro not too far.
Very nice house. The house was new and clean. Nice hosting. If you prefer a calm place than a noise(downtown), i really recommend you here. Near from sol. Very good to take bus,metro or taxi.
The host was friendly and overall, the place was a good stay. Unfortunately it had poor ventilation and smelled damp
Amazing! Jorge it's such a great host. He gave us thousands of suggestions before we even asked for it. The place is stylish as it is in the pictures, and the location is perfect.

Great place, super clean and easy to access. The location is on point if you are trying to spend time around Madrid’s centro area. Minutes away from good places to grab a drink such as Malasaña and Gran Via. Would stay there again.

A great space in a central location! The apartment was very comfortable for two people, right around the corner from grocery stores & bars and a short walk to Palacio Real or Sol. Very clean, a great value for the price. Would stay here again!
Location was perfect, the Place was a little bit small and sofa bed not really comfortable but overall a nice stay

We really liked our stay. The apartment is perfect for 3 and has everything you need. The location for us was perfect and right in the city centre so everything was walkable which is great! The checkin instructions were good and the apartment easy to find. Just one thing you should consider is if you have allergies I wouldn’t recommend this place because two of us were coughing the whole night only in the apartment and we are not sure what is was. Other than that everything was good.

The apartment is very good situated, nice area with a lots of possibilities. To the retiro park only 800 meters. All the interior is very good quality, well decorated with a lot of taste. Everything in the apartment was in best shape, and Gabriel is almost always available if there is a question. Floor heating, which is not very common in Madrid (as I think). AC has the right size, everything nice!

This is as awesome apartment in a great location. The living room and kitchen were very large. Everything is recently renovated. Bathrooms were like a hotel with marble. Gabriel was super nice and helpful. Air conditioning worked well. Would definitely stay here again

Fantastic apartment in an excellent location. Top quality furniture and appliances and it is on a great location Check in was excellent, Gabriel met me at the apartment and showed me everything I need to know Would definitely stay again but unsurprisingly it gets booked up really quick!!
We had an amazing time. The apartment was clean and homely. Good walking distance to the city.

The flat is tiny, but it's wonderful place to stay for a few days. Interior is nice, apartment is clean and equipped with everything you should need. Sometimes you could hear neighbors, but It's not a big problem. location is wery convenient, but nearby streets are dirty. Iwona was wery helpful. In total we get more, then we were waiting.

Iwona is a great host. Very quick in responding and also helpful with any occurring problems. The flat itself is small but perfect for visiting Madrid a couple of days. I can definitely recommend this place...
Great place right in the heart of Lalatina. Very Modern, everything was as described, the A/C was outstanding and it was very clean. Highly Recommend!
Absolutely charming place in a wonderful neighborhood. Don't be scared off by the attic--there's an elevator!

Eduardo’s apartment is fabulous, looks just like the photos and has everything you could ask for. The location is very central and almost all of Madrid’s main attractions are in walking distance, there’s a metro station very close to the apartment as well. Me and my mother really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely like to come again. Thank you Eduardo and Gladice for being so kind and thoughtful!

The apartment was just like the pictures. It was super nice and clean. It was also in a nice location, close to the attractions I wanted to see. Eduardo was good in communicating with me on any questions I had. I will definitely come back again.

Great location! Taxi will drop you off in front of door. You may even ask the taxi to take you to the lockers where you will pick up the keys. For us it wasn’t an inconvenience. We enjoyed out stay and we really would like to come back and keep enjoying Madrid! Host was very responsive. No issues during our stay. Very clean and practical.

The apartment is in a great neighborhood, not even a two minute walk to Cava Baja with w Great restaurant es and tapas bars. 5 min walk to Plaza Major. The apartment had everything we needed. With two bedrooms and two baths. One was attached to one bedroom, the other was in the hallway across the second bedroom. One bedroom had an AC the other a ceiling fan, and in the living room there was another AC until which kept the apartment cool during a very hot August month. The apartment is on the top floor and has an elevator, which was wonderful. The kitchen, although small, had everything needed in there, including a washing machine. We would definitely come back and stay in this part of town. Which is close to everything we needed and in walking distance to tourist interests.
The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was great. Our host was very nice and responded quickly to all of our communications. Would recommend.

Great apartment, we stayed with 2 young children. There was plenty of room and a great location The host was very communicative, even when there was a problem with the elevator in the evening, he made sure to send help and that the problem was fix. Very recommended

We had a lovely stay in this well located apartment. It’s within walking distance of most of the Madrid sights. We walked to the Prado, the Museo Reina Sofia, the palace, although the metro is also close by. Eduardo recommended some great local restaurants and bars. The apartment is cosy and comfortable with everything you could need for a short stay. Communication was helpful and quick.
Great location, everything an Airbnb should be, clean, practical amenities, elevator, and did I say great location?

The flat is located in the heart of historic La Latina with its myriad of tapas bars and restaurants, beautiful winding streets and wonderful central location. Despite being in the centre of the action, the flat is peaceful with amazing views over the rooftops. The beds were comfortable, the flat stylishly furnished and we had everything we needed. Carlos was helpful and responsive. All in all it exceeded our expectations and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it.
The apartment was exactly as advertised and close to many bars and restaurants. Having two keys available was also really helpful.
Amazing amazing amazing place. couldn't find a better location. the house is so clean. so nice. so beautiful. I felt home and More

We had an excellent stay at Carlos’ place in Madrid. Carlos was extremely helpful and responsive, he gave us great recommendations and check in and check out was very straight forward. The air bnb was perfect, exactly as described in a wonderful, central location and had everything we needed. We look forward to visiting again!

Cozy, newly remodeled unit, beautiful beamed ceiling. New paint, new appliances, comfy beds. Good A/C in all rooms. Nice to have 2 bathrooms. Location is really excellent in the middle of everything in La Latina. But the unit is quiet because it is 1 block away from the square, and around a corner. Nice safe & clean neighborhood. Good communication from Carlos. Would recommend to friends and relatives. Thanks Carlos!

Great location! We had a pleasant stay with close proximity to good cafes for brunch. The host took few hours to respond, but we didn’t have any issues during the stay. We recieved clear instructions to enter the house.

Very easy going and super nice from the beginning to the end and also very helpful. The apartment was exactly what we expected from the pictures and the area was also perfect. Everything reachable by walk and/or underground connection. Thanks a lot Gustavo, highly recommend!!!
Super host and great location, only a few steps from Gran Via. Communication was really good. Recommended!!
This apartment in Madrid was conveniently located and quite pleasant to stay in. Pretty quiet despite being in the city center.
Lovely, neat, clean apartment that is well located. Host is great and very responsive. I highly recommend this apartment.
Excellent value. Great location. very clean and well equipped unit. The A/C was a treat with heat this year.
nice home, good communications and easy automated check in. We were 4 people and for spending most of the time outside (exploring Madrid) it was excellent value for money!

Our stay was even better than expected. Really amazing and stylish appartment. Communication went smoothly. Very convenient location as you can walk to almost anything in the city centre. We would definitely be happy to come back or recommend to any of our friends staying in Madrid.

This beautiful space is perfect for a larger group (we had 7) in the heart of downtown Madrid. The living room and dining room were great to relax in and plan our adventure for the day. Great space to stay in.

This is the place! Close to everything. We walked in all directions and saw the beautiful town, then at night we’d come back to the apartment, clean up and saunter out for dinner. The apartment itself is very big and our group of five had plenty of space. Three bathrooms made our large group seem like luxury instead of dormitory. Washer and dryer always make travel easier (yes it was chocolate sauce!) And I love having the fridge. Mornings were coffee and tea in the apartment, yoga (the living room is that big) then off to buy a pastry. We loved Mercado San Miguel and had a great tapas dinner there. That’s a five minute walk.

The apartment location is fantastic! Easy to walk to many shops, metro, restaurants. Love the Coffee Roasters cafe right out the door! The apartment is well appointed and feels like home. We would definitely stay here again.
Great location. Everything within walking distance. Comfortable space for 6. Modern decor was pleasing. Very clean and well kept. Would recommend to travelers considering a trip to Madrid.

A really unique and beautiful apartment, with a lot of personality. It felt like coming home. Super cool and cozy. The neighborhood and location is really nice as well. Mariana is very friendly and welcoming. Would highly recommend this place, and would love to come back!

Marianna’s place is certainly very cute and charming, however extremely noisy specially at night. It was quite challenging to have a full night sleep. there is no storage for clothing and access to her place is difficult if carrying a large suitcase.

A great experience of stayed in chueca, l like the atmosphere here. John and his lover are warm hearted and very friendly. l like their dog ，lovely ruben.The room have a good location,you can visit every tourism attractions by foot in 20min. There are many bar and restaurant nearby.
Location, location, location. For the price paid, it is truly in a great location in a really lovely neighbourhood. John is very accommodating and even checked me in a bit earlier.

I flew to Madrid to then go by train to Gijón where I planned to stay for a week. I needed a place to stay for one night before heading north. I made a good choice staying at Rubén's: terrific location (a stone's throw from Puerta del Sol), a great vibe, good eats everywhere, and my very accommodating host allowed me to do an early check-in. I left at 6 AM in the rain, but a cab happened to be right on the corner and I was whisked away to close this fun mini-chapter.

I had a great stay! Location is excellent — in a cool neighbourhood and just steps away from the metro. The place was as described, clean and comfortable. Jaime did my check-in and was very friendly and accommodating. He even allowed me to drop off my suitcase/check-in ahead of schedule, which gave me several extra hours to enjoy the city! Great communication from both Rubén and Jaime. Thanks for being excellent hosts. Hope to visit Madrid again soon.

I loved stay at Rubén's place. It was a bit tiny but everything is comfortable and clean--the AC works extremely well for those interested in coming during the summer months. The place is centrally located--about a ten minute walk from Gran Via and in a pretty nice neighborhood with lots of shops around. Check-in and out was super easy and Rubén was super responsive and helpful throughout!

The location of the apartment was excellent ! In a pleasant neighborhood, near the center, and across the most lovely bar (excellent for breakfast in the morning !). We felt that we could not have stayed at a better place !! The apartment has very recently been renovated and has all the comfort ! Even though we arrived past midnight, we were welcomed and shown into the apartment. We had a magnificent long weekend at Madrid and this apartment and it's location did contribute to that !!

The flat is super stylish and spacious. The kitchen is well equipped even though it is a touristic apartment. I really enjoyed how big the shower is. The only “but” for me is the noise outside, but I guess that’s the price to pay when you are so central. The hosts were helpful, communicative and super nice!

The accommodation was nice and within walking distance of restaurants as well as the well known El Retiro park. The only thing that we did not realize is that there is no elevator, may be an issue if you have heavy luggage.

This location was very convenient but do note that there are a lot of bars in this neighborhood. In the morning, I saw vomit a few times on the streets. On our last night, it was scary because I woke to the wall shaking and shouting at 6 am from the unit next door. I wasn’t sure what was happening but I realized it was probably drunk people. Not that it’s the owners fault but this was really scary.
The hosts were nice and were prompt in responses. We enjoyed the stay as it was close to everything. Cheers!
Lovely modern apartment. The location is perfect as it’s situated near the Gran Via. The place was clean and tidy, with good amenities. Check-in was straight forward. Would definitely recommend.
The apartment was in a great location with great little coffee shops and restaurants. The beds were very comfortable. The place is spotless. The host was very responsive.
Fantastic air b&b for a few days with friends in Madrid 😊 It’s a really stylish pad & in a fun area which actually isn’t too noisy at night. Would highly recommend!
Nice place clean and tide very well equipped and easy to check in and very nice beds the only con was no elvator other than that I had a nice time staying there

Maria Luis was a very good host. The apartment really nice , clean, quiet and the top in the cherry is that is very close to everything. Even though you are at the downtown area and Chueca , the apartment is really quiet.

Great location! You will be right in the middle of the shopping area close to Gran Via and Sol. The apartment is also very spacious and the building has an elevator. Maria Luisa is a great communicator!
Location and cleanliness make this the type of place I could recommend to any person wanting the most out of the central of Madrid!

The apartment is a lovely spacious one-bedroom, with a good-size galley kitchen (not a converted cupboard as they can sometimes be -- you could comfortably cook here!) bedroom, bathroom and living room. Despite its central location with all the advantages that brings, it was also quiet. I had a great time staying here and would highly recommend it! Maria was also very helpful in meeting me to check in and even met me at the train station to give me a charger I had foolishly left behind. Thanks!
anto is a kindness and available guy .really good quality price and the 2 garages are very convenients best regards

Perfect big apartment, in case you are staying with a group. We were with 6 and the apartment was defintely big enough. 3 sleeping rooms, one sofa to sleep on, 2 bathrooms. Also the location is great, no issues with traffic sound, and a metrostop around the corner. Also the disco El Kapital is just crossing the street ;) I can definitely recommand to book this apartment if you are searching one in Madrid.

We loved our stay at Monica’s place. The location is perfectly close to sooo many things. The apartment has everything we needed and was beautiful. Clean, bright, airy, spacious, modern decor. We had a great stay. Thank you!
The house was immaculate and she even had water, wine and milk for us ready when we checked in. The location is perfect and makes walking places very easy! I would stay here again!!

Had a great experience at the Airbnb and the host was super helpful. The apartment was tastefully designed and built. The only sore point was that the apartment is located on the second floor and there is no elevator in the building.

The location of the Airbnb was superb, right in the heart of Madrid, making it incredibly convenient for exploring the city's many attractions. We were within walking distance of major landmarks, great restaurants, and vibrant nightlife. The apartment itself was clean and well-maintained but also beautifully decorated. It had a cozy, modern design that instantly made us feel at home. We appreciated the attention to detail in providing everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was outstanding in their communication and hospitality. They provided us with valuable local tips, including recommendations for nearby. I would definitely recommend.

monica's place is beautiful. it is concise, appointed with everything you need and nothing you do not. the space is climate controlled with cold water under the floors. this worked perfectly and made a very pleasant respite from the heat. highly recommend to the highest level. it is just a great place.
Location was great as I expected, the studio was clean, also the Nelson who was contacted me was very friendly and let me to leave my suitcase before check in time, I recommend this place

Incredibly quiet! Even though the appartement is in the middle of bustling Chueca, if the neighbours are out there is almost absolute silence, even on a Saturday night with people all around the street. I hope to go here again when I visit Madrid again. Everything else was fine too, but location plus quietness is the big selling point.
The apartment is very central for tourists. It is easy walking distance to Gran Via, hop on hop off bus and attractions
I really enjoyed staying in the small flat. It is very pleasantly quiet and it is very easy to sleep. Everything was there for a short stay. Thank you very much and I would like to come back:)
The flat was absolutely beautiful, in an amazing location and Marcelo was an incredible host. Would highly recommend to other guests and would love to stay here again.

This is a wonderful place, definitely a 10/10! It's a 15 minute stroll from Madrid's main train station and about the same distance to Puerta del Sol, the main square in the city centre. Lot's of good restaurants and bars nearby and when you wake up in the morning the only sound you will hear are the birds singing, it seems incredible how quiet it is inside the flat. WiFi worked great, everything was totally clean and nice, kitchen fully furnished, washing machine, etc. Everything perfect. And last but not least: Contact with Marcelo was always very easy and quick, he is very friendly and helpful and made really everything to make my stay as nice as possible: There was fresh milk and two bottles of wine in the fridge! Great suggestions for restaurants and cafés nearby and I was received by a human being who showed me around the flat, a thing that unfortunately has become very rare at airbnb.
Marcelo is a great host, and his place is a terrific base for a stay in Madrid. Highly recommended.
Fran’s place was spacious, clean and well equipped. The location was ideal to get to the airport the next day. Would highly recommend for accommodation in Madrid.
Beautiful apartment, located at the center of the gran via and the host is very nice offered us a late leaving in order to help us out
The location was perfect! we liked it a lot. We habe been 3 girls, and had a lot of space.

The host is very friendly and responsive, the apartment is very nice. The downside is that is located in a sketchy street, a lot of prostitutes standing outside the building and coming in and out of the building. Not recommended if you are traveling with kids.

The apartment is beautifully styled and clean! Has everything that you need and is located central to everything so can walk everywhere or if you need, it is right near the metro station. Leeway’s were great with communicating and made our stay very enjoyable, couldn’t recommend this apartment any more!
Very clean and fairly good value. Check in process was slightly impersonal since it was a « self check-in » process. That aside, we had a great stay and would come back here again!

The apartment is fine . The area is a little noisy from the street, and it’s in an area that’s not Great ...it’s okay ....just its not the most sophisticated area . A good 24 h Supermarket is very close.
Beautiful space, central location, spotless upon arrival and exceptional communication from the host throughout our stay!
I truly enjoyed our stay, it was a lovely apartment. Very well decorated, practical and very close to the city center. People always around, restaurants and bars are close.

Marta is a very nice host, she waited us in the apartment and gave us detailed instructions on facility usage and even advice of sightseeing. The apartment is just looks like the pic on bnb, all the facilities are new and clean. It's really a cozy place. There are 2 metro lines nearby and easy to connect with all the main places. And, walk is also possible as it is in the center and walking itself is the Best way to know the city. The is a supermarket, carrefour, within about 200 meters and lots of restaurant around the building, suitable for travelling with family and friends. Highly recommend!
Very nice apartment and very clean. 10-15 min walking distance to all major attractions, very good location. Host communication was very quick, within minutes. Overall very happy with our stay.

This apartment was perfect for a week in Madrid. It was exactly as pictured and very clean. It was within walking distance (anywhere from 10-25 mins) of everything we wanted to see in old Madrid. Marta was great communicating the time to arrive and get keys and responded quickly if we had questions. I highly recommend this place!

Had an amazing time in Madrid. Marta was very communicative and accommodative and made sure we had everything we needed. She also gave great food recs. The unit was clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated.

Marta and Arturo were very helpful and attentive to our needs. They arranged transportation for us at our arrival, and provided great suggestions for restaurants around the area. The apartment is very well equipped and clean, and it is located close to several places to visit. We highly recommend it!

Great place to stay in madrid. Easy access to amazing historical sites of madrid, shopping and restaurants. 20 or 30 euro by bolt or uber to the airport if you dont fancy negotiating train systems. Apartment has more that everything you would need for your stay.
Beautiful, spacious, pristine, great location yet quiet with windows closed. Would definitely recommend and stay again. Host was super responsive and nice.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment! It was very light and stylish apartment filled with everything you need! Location was good - we even walked to city centre as it was very nice walk to see this area. And we found shopping centre very close to this apartment. Superb! We will defenetely use this apartment again if we stay in Madrid! Thank you so much!!!

Great value, clean, and a quite location from the downtown hustle and bustle. All you could want in a home away from home atmosphere. I would stay here again and recommend this place to family and friends.

This apartment was beautiful and well decorated. Everything looked new and clean. Our hosts were friendly, helpful and worked with us when our arrival time was delayed. There are places to eat nearby and the neighborhood seemed nice. Many of the things to see and do in Madrid are a short cab/uber or bus ride away. It was hot (39C/102F) while we were visiting so we stayed out of the afternoon heat as much as possible by visiting some of the great museums around Madrid.

Chic apartment in a good area of Madrid. Within walking distance to all the major sights. Susanna and Nacho made us feel welcome and gave us useful tourist information. Air conditioning would have made sleeping easier, so if you are not used to the heat or humidity this could be a difficulty.
A charming spot in an ideal location. Javier was a wonderful host and offered great suggestions for Madrid.

Javier was really helpful and friendly and we were really stoked to find his place available for our stay. It’s a super central location with great transport access and easy to walk around the city / get metro or trains / get to the airport with the shuttle etc. As it is very central there was some noise on a night but this shouldn’t deter you from booking as it’s really well placed and serviced apartment. You couldn’t get more central so if you’re a light sleeper take some ear plugs as it’s definitely worth booking this spot. We’ll look to book again when we come back to Madrid.

I can't say enough good things about this place. Very walkable to all the museums and other places of interest in Madrid. The apartment is very nice also. Great air conditioning and very hot water. It's on the first floor, so no walking up stairs. Great Madrid.

As a host, David was quick to respond with any questions or concerns. Check-in was very easy as well. The apartment is fantastic and well maintained. He was also kind enough to include a hand-drawn map of the neighborhood. Highly recommend this airbnb. Thanks again David.

David place is very spacious, clean and welcoming. I had a great stay from the easy checking (face to face ), tips and guide about the surroundings blocks and fast response. The apartment is located in a quite street but just a few minutes walk from bars, cafes and shopping area. Thanks again !

My stay at Manuela’s apartment was amazing! She is a great host and the apartment is very comfortable. Situated at the heart of a very lively neighborhood Manuela’s apartment is a quiet oasis. Would come back any day.

Amazing place. Manuela is really a top-notch host! She provides us with amazing recommendations for restaurants and places around the neighborhood, and the apartment is super clean, tidy, and comfortable. Perfect if you are traveling with a friend or alone. There’s even a washing machine! The apartment is also extremely well located in Madrid’s best neighborhood for dining out and cool little bars. Would high recommend this place! I’ll definitely be staying there again when I return.
Beautiful flat in a very good location ! Manuela is a very good host ! I recommend !

Manuela's apartment was a very nice place to stay for a few nights in Madrid. Everything was clean and as shown in the listing, and Manuela was always helpful and responsive with lots of recommendations for places to eat and shop nearby. It's not the place to stay if you're looking for a private getaway, as the neighbors are extremely close by and not always quiet. But it's the perfect location for exploring the heart of Madrid on foot.

Manuela is an amazing host. She leaves you recommendations and debriefs you on the local area. The flat is on ground floor, so no stairs! It is on an inclined street if that’s important to you. The ceilings are tall which helped keep the place cool. The entry area has a large table that can be used as a great work space! The bedroom windows look out to an inner courtyard that neighbors may walk by so I never opened them fully, but you absolutely could. The neighborhood is vibrant and just steps away from a nice Mercadona. I loved it here so much!

The most responsive and helpful host! Still can’t believe we were able to find such a perfect Airbnb. Nothing was too far, anything outside of a 20 minute walk we would easily take the metro. Such a beautiful neighborhood and the most central location we could imagine. Manuela’s recommendations were spot on and so delicious! Would stay here again and again!
The perfect apartment for a visit to Madrid. Manuela was friendly and helpful. I recommend her place and would definitely stay again!
Manuels is a fantastic hostess. She provided many helpful touches such as umbrellas and kitchen staples. Definitely will stay there again.

I stayed in Isabel’s apartment for a month from September to October. I was so genuinely sad to leave as I has definitely gotten attached to the place during my time there. It’s so homey and cozy, right in the center of La Latina neighborhood which is my absolute favorite part of Madrid. The terrace (especially during the summer months) is such a gem and I spent so much of my time out there, both day and night. I always felt safe in the neighborhood and there was always so much to do. Super convenient Dia grocery store right around the corner too. The apartment is exactly as you see in the pictures. My only regret is that I didn’t stay for longer. I also worked remotely from this apartment and the wifi is excellent and super fast. Never had any issues or lags during my zoom meetings. Thank you and Paloma for your hospitality Isabel! I will definitely be back and can fully say I whole heartedly recommend this place!

We stayed for 2 months and love the place. It is very close to most of the tourist spots in Madrid. Restaurants and grocery stores are very close to the apartment. I would certainly love to stay here again when I come back to Madrid in a couple of years
Place was great, very well located with easy access to transportation, restaurants and attractions. The apartment was clean and with all the amenities as described.

It was a very good staying! Location is great - right in the heart of the so called "la vida mandrillena" The host was very flexible and solved our questions at once! Marvelous balcony and lots of space to every of our 11 person group I would recommend it defiantly

This apartment was a fantastic place to stay. It is close to a lot of activities and it was impeccably clean and fresh looking. Esther was very helpful and communication was superb. You can’t go wrong by staying here! 👍👍
This rental was in a truly excellent central location. It was everything that we hoped for and needed for our vacation in Spain.
Beautiful area. Nice apartment. Very Clean. Suggestions for the area and local information would have been helpful.

We had a wonderful stay at Penta’s place. It was spacious, modern, clean, comfortable, quiet, and was a short walk to everything we wanted (food, shopping, sights, subway) She was a great communicator, and made everything easy. Would totally stay here again, and would recommend to others.

We love Madrid. This apartment was everything described and so much more for the 4 of us. 3 full baths was awesome. Location, restaurants, shopping, night life and of course the vibe that is Madrid . Penta our host was super helpful and answered all our questions. Excellent 🥰

Juanma's apartment is just as everyone says- perfect location, great for a short stay for a single or couple. It's in close proximity to a few metro stations and it's also easy to walk everywhere around central. Check-in was easy and Juanma was flexible to work around when my flight got in. Would definitely recommend this flat- central Madrid but with the feeling of a nice neighbourhood area!

The apartment is located right in the city centre, you can walk everywhere. I was surprised by how warm and comfy it is. The shower and bed are perfect for relax. It was totally worth it and Juanma is a super host! 5 stars
Small cozy and functional space next to everything without being noisy. Juanma is a genuine and helpful host - would stay here again!

Great space for a large group. We are a group of 15 and we had plenty of space. It was super hot in Madrid and thankfully all the ACs worked great and our time inside the house was very comfortable. Location is perfect, would stay again.

The apartment was very central, however the air con did not work for the duration of our holiday, which was almost unbearable in the hot summer temperatures. We had very little help and the issue was not resolved/ they seem uninterested to help which was very disappointing.

We booked the apartment for a group retreat with several colleagues and we were very happy with the place. It is very spacious and there is definitely enough space for more than 10 people to sit comfortably. It is also very convenient to have so many bedrooms and bathrooms. The are was very central, with easy access to many sights in Madrid as well as to plenty of good restaurants and shops. Definitely a recommendation for bigger groups!

We thought the location was great and the flat has a great size for a weekend! Maria's mum welcomed us and was super friendly and even showed us around in the neighborhood to find restaurants and supermarkets. Check in was flexible and we were even able to leave our luggage all day in the apartment, because there weren't any guests coming after us! The beds (1 coach, 1 bed) weren't too comfortable sadly - it was fine for a weekend though! Thanks for having us and we definitely recommend the apartment!

We are upset to say that our check-out experience was extremely discerning. We were told by Luz, the host, that check out was at 12 pm (also listed on Airbnb) and two individuals let themselves into the apartment at 10:30 am without knocking. We were both naked and unprepared to leave as we were under the impression we had until 12 pm. Nonetheless we quickly packed our things and were pushed out at 11 am. This not only was invalid information and expectations but an invasion of our privacy. Other than that the toilet seat was broken and felt the apartment was unequipped for a guest stay (laundry and cooking essentials). We will not be back nor can we recommend this place to future guests.

Great value and location! The apartment is compact but the price reflects that. Overall a great stay! The double bed was super comfy and the apartment is a one minute walk from the 6 Circular metro and a major bus stop. There is also a grocery store and giant, beautiful park less than a 5 minute walk away. Would stay again!

We had a wonderful time in Madrid staying in Luz Maria’s apartment. The location was great — within walking distance of a number of Madrid’s attractions and extremely easy to take the bus or metro for others. The apartment is right next to a metro stop which made traveling very easy. The neighborhood also had a number of nice cafes, a local market, and supermarket all within easy walking of the apartment. The apartment itself has everything you would need and the bed was comfortable. It was quiet at night and we had a sound sleep. It was a perfect place to stay for our weekend trip in Madrid. Thank you, Luz Maria!

I can not recommend this flat highly enough. The owners are thoughtful, helpful and warm. Ana went out of her way to respond to all my restaurant and transportation questions. The flat itself is so clean, stylish and well appointed with everything a family needs to be comfortable and happy. It is a stone’s throw from Plaza Mayor and loads of great restaurants and cafes. Perfecto!

We absolutely loved staying at Ana's place. The location was perfect -- very central and in a safe and charming neighborhood. The apartment was beautiful and well decorated. And the beds are incredibly comfortable! The kitchen and bathrooms were well stocked with all the amenities you could need. But the best part of all was the thoughtfulness of our wonderful host, Ana. Our flight was delayed by three hours and we arrived at the apartment after 1:00 a.m. Not only did Ana meet us at the apartment, she brought food and drinks for our hungry family of four. It was just what we needed after a long day. Ana clearly cares about her guests and it was what made our trip to Madrid very special. I HIGHLY recommend Ana's place!
Beautiful place with an excellent location and Ana was also very helpful at check-in. Would recommend!

Excellent communication and service. Lovely apartment. Ana set us up with some essentials for coffee and quick first day sandwiches of ham, bread, and cheese. Loved the location. We came by car and parking was easy. Would 100% stay here again.

Ana was a fantastic host. The reviews are 100% accurate. I asked her to get me some welcome flowers for my daughter, wife, and mother in law to welcome them to Madrid. She went above and beyond for us and it was greatly appreciated. She checked in after the first day to make sure we had everything we needed, and again the night before we checked out. Would stay here again upon a hopeful revisit to Madrid!

Thank you Ana for making our quick stay in Madrid amazing. The apartment was a great location where we could walk to any food, shopping and tourist locations. Everything in the apartment was just like the pictures or better. Ana went above and beyond to let us drop off our luggage early, show us the features of the apartment, give us recommendations for food and things to do and help us with a taxi when it was time to leave. We would definitely recommend staying in this apartment.
This place was great, it left a very good memory of my first time in Madrid. The location, amazing.

This is our first airbnb experience and it was a great one. Our family enjoyed our stay at Ana's place. The location is perfect, the place is clean and more than big enough for four people. We highly recommend this place. Ana is a super host, very attentive/responsive, we were very well taken of. If there is any issue, reach out to her right away and she will make sure to resolve it. Thank you!
Ana was the best host! She was super responsive and shared many tips and restaurants. The location was fantastic and the apartment very well laid out, just like the photos.

Wow! Ana's apartment exceeded all my expectations and the pictures don't do it justice. I stayed here with my elderly parents and the space was perfect for us. The apartment is large and the two bed/two bath set up was perfect. The mattresses were super comfortable. The living room is separated from the other bedrooms by the kitchen. There is Netflix on the tv and the wifi worked well. We went in January and the heating worked wonderfully. The apartment is also sound proof from the hustle and bustle of outside. While the apartment is one floor up, there is a lift that allows you to walk down a half flight for those that are a bit less mobile. The location is perfect. Right by Plaza Mayor and walkable to so much. I was so happy with this AirBnB experience. When I return to Madrid, I will definitely be staying here. Ana was such a wonderful and responsive host.

The apartment is spacious, clean, and conveniently equipped with all necessary amenities. Its central location is ideal for tourists, with restaurants, supermarkets, and attractions within walking distance. Despite its central location, the apartment remains remarkably quiet once the windows are closed. The shower's hot water stream could be stronger, but it was good enough for us. Ana, our host, made us feel at home right away. She was incredibly responsive throughout our stay, always ready to assist with any inquiries or requests. She even went the extra mile by arranging airport transportation and sharing a detailed list of recommended restaurants and places to visit in Madrid.

We spend four days in this apartment, every things as we expected. The location was perfect near important spots for us. The apartment big, well-furnished. The host Ana, very friendly and helpful thank you for every thing, we had a great stay at the apartment. Definitely, I’ll recommend the apartment to my family and friends. Thanks Shaikha

Ana is a fabulous host! The apartment is exactly as described and a welcome oasis in the middle of the city when the crowds have got too much. Everything is within walking distance - fabulous restaurants, bars and shops and all of the historic museums and palace. Ana was so helpful with recommendations, met us on check in and booked a taxi for us. Would definitely recommend.

Clara and Amir were great hosts. I arrived a little late on check in date and Clara waited for me with the keys and didn’t charge extra. We had one small issue with the bathroom and she was very quick to fix it. The space is beautiful and clean, just like the photos. Will definitely stay again if in Madrid.

Amir’s apartment is an excellent choice for a place to stay while visiting Madrid. The apartment is super cute, very clean, and it’s in a great location. Both Amir and Clara were super responsive and went out of their way to help us accommodate parking our rental car. We very much appreciated their hospitality during our stay.

The location of the appartement is great, the city center is in walking distance and in a nice area with cafés and bars but still quiet. There is enough space for groups and allows for a comfortable stay. The communication with the host was great and messages were answered very fast. We enjoyed the stay a lot and recommend it everyone.
Great flat and great location. Clara is very welcoming and great to see an Airbnb that has a well stocked kitchen so you can cook.

Great location, big space and flows well. Very comfortable stay. Cute touches throughout. Clara went out of her way to give us tips for places and she even organized the taxi ride for us the morning we went to the airport. Superb!
Our family really enjoyed our stay in Clara’s apartment. It was very close to all kinds of sights, shops, bars and restaurants. The apartment was clean and the interior was very nice 😊

The apartment was exactly as listed - it was spotless and spacious, comfortable beds, lovely kitchen, 3 reasonably sized bedrooms. The location was just amazing - easy access to restaurants, bars, shops, markets as well as within easy walking distance from all the tourist places and if not, the underground was so easy to use. There were no problems with noise within the apartment and it felt very safe. The communications from Amir and then Clara were excellent. Clara met us at the apartment, having given us instructions on how to get there, and spent time giving us excellent recommendations, and then arranging a taxi back to the airport for us. Clara definitely knows her coffee shops! We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Madrid and would definitely recommend staying in this apartment, it was wonderful. We hope to come back one day and would definitely look for this apartment again.

Clara was a fantastic 10 out of 10 in hosting us, and the apartment met all of our needs and more. The only drawback to our stay was the off-on construction that was going on in one of the neighboring apartments from 8 a.m. to roughly 4 p.m., mostly when we were out doing tourist things. If I ever visit Madrid, I will stay with Clara again.

This apartment was perfect for a 3-person trip! The apartment and amenities were just as pictured, maybe even better. The location was great and easy to walk to everything we wanted to do in Madrid, and a bonus is El Rastro on Sundays is literally right outside the front door. Clara was a great host - she let us drop off our stuff much earlier than check-in while the place was still being cleaned, which was so convenient for our early flight. She also gave us so many great recommendations and was super responsive to all our questions. Would definitely recommend this place and stay here again!

Loved the place and highly recommend. Clara was amazing from beginning to the end. Always quick to answer questions and even let us leave our luggage on the day of departure. Very close to metro, but also easy to walk to center. You'll find supermarkets, restaurants and cute shops very close by. Only issue was the noise during the night, by the apartment neighbors, but that cannot be controlled. So just take some ear plugs and a sleep mask (no blackouts, just curtains) and you'll have a wonderful trip to Madrid.

Our host was super sweet and friendly. We arrived before the check in time because of our flight. Clara let us check in early. She is very accommodating and helpful. The apartment was also very clean. Our family traveled to different cities in Spain and this apartment was the one we enjoyed the most. We loved our stay in her apartment. Thank you again Clara!

We had a great stay at this apartment! It’s very comfortable and exactly as shown in the photos – everything matched the listing perfectly. The neighborhood is excellent, with plenty of supermarkets, shops, and restaurants nearby. It’s very easy to get around on foot, and there are at least two metro stations within a short walking distance. The host was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely stay here again!

Fantastic Apartment! It was exactly as described, clean, functional, comfy beds and close to everything! Perfect for our family of 6. We loved the neighborhood (La Latina), so lively and colorful. We went walking everywhere in Madrid downtown. Clara is a wonderful host.

The location is amazing. Close to the metro, but also walking distance to so many restaurants and stores. We walked to plaza mayor and it was so pleasant. The home itself is the absolute cutest. A little home away from home. Super clean and all the proper amenities. Clara was so helpful and I cannot stress that enough. We were also sent lots of recommendation’s and were fortunate to have experienced a little of the local life. We will definitely be returning. Thank you for having us.
All my family was happy to stay here, surely if we come back will choose it again. Good host, with clear instructions.

I wish we could give Maria's apartment a 10 star review. The apartment was easy to access, spacious, comfortable, sparkling clean with an amazing location. Maria was prompt with responses to our questions or concerns. I would recommend her apartment to others and I will stay again in future trips to Madrid.

Amazing location, excellent unit, quick responses. Allowed us to check in earlier, only 2 cons are we did not have hot water when we arrived (but it was fixed fast) and there's no storage option upon check-out. I strongly recommend to stay with them for a pleasant visit in Madrid!!!
spacious and comfortable apartment, lools even better in person. Raul was very pleasent to deal with. Would absolutely recommend.
Very good place and very well located. The host was very friendly and the price was very reasonable. All in all a great place and a good experince. Many thanks.

A comfortable stay for five friends, with a warm and friendly welcome from Hector - thank you! Conveniently located in a lively area, but with no street noise inside. No unnecessary frills, but everything you need.

I had a great stay at Isabel’s place! Great location and cute apartment. Apartment was very clean, check-in was easy, great shower as well. Apt is in a great location and close to public transportation.

We recently had the pleasure of staying here, and I wanted to express our heartfelt gratitude for such a wonderful experience. My wife, our one-year-old son, and I thoroughly enjoyed every moment of our stay. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The attention to detail in the apartment was remarkable. It was not just a place to stay but a true home away from home. The cozy atmosphere and thoughtfully curated amenities made our stay exceptionally comfortable. The location was ideal, allowing us to explore the vibrant streets of Madrid with ease. We appreciated the proximity to local attractions, restaurants, and shops, which made our daily outings with our little one convenient and enjoyable. Your responsiveness and helpful suggestions added an extra layer of comfort to our trip. It's evident that you care about your guests' experiences and go above and beyond to ensure they have a memorable stay. Thank you for accommodating us!
The appartment is well located and super nice. Alvaro was available for any questions and super kind
Amazing place, Alvaro was lovely and very quick to respond. The house was super well equipped and in what i believe to be the best area in madrid! I had an amazing experience.

We had a nice stay in Alvaro’s apartment and he was a great host as very responsive and kind. A situation happened at check in and he solved it immediately. We had a late flight and he was super accommodating with us on that part so we are very thankful to him! He also provides very interesting recommendations of things around and especially restaurants. The apartment itself is very stylish and the two bathrooms are a must. Bravo Alvaro and thank you very much!
Very nice apartment. Pretty and clean. Great location. We were a couple with a kid and having a bed in a separate room was good.

Beautiful room in a beautiful old building. The location is wel connected to the metro and has plenty of places for food and drinks around. Because it's an old building be mindfull of noise you make to your neighbours. Álvaro is a gracious host and made sure we had everything we needed. Responsive and flexible when we needed him. 5 stars!

Simply superb! Great apartment in a beautiful and historic building with one of the best equipped kitchens that we have seen on our Airbnb stays. The downstairs bedroom with large double bed and ensuite was so comfortable, while the area upstairs with a double mattress is ideal for kids who want a bit of their own space! Álvaro himself is so helpful and professional and genuinely tries to ensure guests have the best possible experience. Alonso Martínez is a great, well connected area of Madrid that is close enough to the centre but has less of the tourist crowds. Nearby Plaza Olavide is a lovely spot to soak up some sun and sample typical tapas with locals on the many terraces and there is a decent playground for young kids!
The apartment is in great location, walkable to many places and super close to the metro. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable, we had a great time
Wondeful Place, very clean and excelente location! Álvaro is a great host, very helpful and ready to help you! When we come back to Madrid , we will stay again in Alvaro’s place.
Alvaro was an excellent host. The space was clean, well appointed and lovely. Great location, as well. We will stay again the next time we travel to Madrid!!

Alvaro's place was great. All the amenities met the expectations. In the mornings I could smell breakfast being cooked somewhere in the building, not in my apartment. I stayed in one of the units between two others, so at times I could hear some of the other tenant's conversation. I don't hold Alvaro responsible for either of my listed nuisances. The building is historic and I understand there are certain restrictions to the architectural design of the apartments. Alvaro is very responsive and proactive. I enjoyed his place and the ability to get anywhere in Madrid fast and easily.

Great stay at Madrid. Álvaro is a great host. He was really attentive and responsive to all our inquiries. The place is a gem in the city. It is comfortable and modern without loosing its antique charm. Highly recommended.

Antonio was an incredible host! His level of responsiveness and concern for his guest(s) is absolutely unmatched. Every detail of this property was spectacular... from the cleanliness, location, check-in and the various amenities that Antonio provided his guest(s). I certainly recommend this property to anyone! Antonio is beyond a doubt a SUPER HOST!

Small studio but with all the essentials needed: possibility to cook simple meals and also washing machine at our disposition. Ideal for one person but 2 person is ok too which was my case. Great if you work/tour/study and don't stay much at home and just want privacy and independence at night. Supermarkets nearby. Area is in /near Chinatown of madrid. Ramón is contactable through Airbnb app. Excellent check-in and out process - very easy. Thanks Ramón for the stay.

Lovely, spacious, older apartment. Comfly bed. Wifi works well. Great location....just a 4min walk from the HSLU and UN Tourism university building. Nice restaurants nearby. Bathroom ceiling had water damage from the apartment above, but that is getting fixed. Host gave info proactively and was solution oriented. I would stay here next time I am here in Madrid.

We stayed here almost a week as we wanted to stay near Santiago Bernabeu. It was a 10 min walk from this house, nice location, calm environment, has everything for short stay. The air-condition worked perfectly for very hot days/nights. Enrique was fast in responses and understands the needs. Will come back again and 100% recommended.
The landlord is nice and generous. The house is close to the stadium. And the area is nice and quiet.

The location is convenient. The host was awating for us and the explanation very nice. It is fully equipped. The pictures describe the apartment in a very precise way and the comunication was easy and fast.
This place is in a good location - close to tours, shopping, metro, market, etc. Maria showed us the place and was very welcoming. Thanks, Maria!

Lovely studio apartment with all amenities. There’s hot water and heating which was great for the February cold. Basically at Plaza mayor. Close to the metro and a lot of other shops. So so convenient.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a short stay. Easy communication with the host and great location in a hip area of Madrid. Good coffee shops and restaurants near by.

Such a great location nearby to Park Retiro, metro stations, museums and the main bus station. The apartment was larger than expected, modern and really clean and perfect for families, with a lovely private outdoor terrace too. The water and cleaning starter pack were lovely touches. Would recommend.
Cute little air bnb in a neighborhood outside of the main downtown area. The apartment had everything we needed and it was a short Uber ride to downtown Madrid. We would stay again.

Great host who was very fast to respond to any questions and told us everything to get in and made us feel right at home! Great place for a group of friends to go out and enjoy the beauty of Madrid and have a comfortable and clean place to sleep and start each day!

Not what expected. Felt more like a hostel. Thin walls and very odd layout. I could hear everything the next unit was saying or doing. The odd bathroom setup with the tub/ shower butted up against another standup shower. They were both connected and only a shower curtain to separate them. The sofa bed mattress had a noticeable huge dips and creaky support frame. Would not stay here again. Luckily we were there for only one night.

Great location!! Was worried at first about how quiet the street was, if it would be safe at night but the street was nicely lit and we felt safe at all times. 3 floor walk up! Not the end of the world depending on how many bags you have and how heavy they are. Washer/dryer was awesome and we were given a detergent pod :D Apt was super clean! AC worked well. Cooled the apt very quickly. All utensils were available. They even had a charger adapter which came in super handy as we forgot ours! Being that it is an attic, the ceiling in the bathroom is very low. I am 5’6 and I had trouble with it. But my gf is 5’2 and she was fine. Definitely not a deal breaker! The host was super accommodating and responded quickly. Would definitely recommend!

A great little spot to stay that is super central! It was very clean, had a nice washer to use, and cozy. The ceilings are quite low in a couple places (like above the toilet), so this may be a difficult spot to stay if you are very tall. We had a few head bonks haha. But besides that it was a great place to stay!

The apartment is perfect for two people, it is small and cosy, but has everything you need for a shorter stay. It is perfectly situated in the city, close to the city center and everything within walking distance. Sara is also very helpful and easy to contact.

Clean and cute apartment with everything you need for a short visit to Madrid. Only one stop to the city center by metro or less than 10 minutes on foot. The host was very kind, as she allowed us to check in before the scheduled time and she also allowed us to leave our suitcases in the apartment until late afternoon, as we had a late evening flight back home. We highly recommend this place for a short city break in Madrid:)

The Aparment is clean and cozy. This place is good for short stays. There is no lift so if you have heavy bags it can be complicated. Highly recommend if you are looking for a place to crash for 1-2 nights.

The place is excellent, just as described. It is tastefully designed and has everything you may need for a short stay. What I liked the most was the location. Just steps away from the metro and at fairly short walking distance from Madrid’s highlights. While I didn’t meet Moncho, communication was great and the check-in process was really smooth.
Simple, clean space - nice area near some great locations but tucked away on a more residential street. Our first time in Madrid was a success and we really appreciated the great hospitality!
The house was clean and comfortable. It takes only two minutes to get to the metro station and around 10 minutes to Alsa bus station. My friend specifically likes the mattress which is comfortable.
Comfortable stay. Good communication and a perfect location close to Atocha railway station, groceries, etc. Recommended.
The place id perfect for a short stay: location, cleanliness, style, personal touch. The keys/check in and out are a bit complicated. But otherwise, I would totally recommend to everybody.

Our stay here was wonderful. The apartment is beautiful and very clean. We found the location to be great for our stay. We were well taken care of by the host, and their communication was superb. Fantastic stay all around, highly reccomend.

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. A very comfortable bed! Andrea is a great host and there when you need her. It’s in a great location, close to metro, restaurants and shops. It’s a perfect size for a couple looking to getaway. We had a great stay! Thank you!
Perfectly located beautiful apartment. Was very happy with it. And highly recommend it.

I booked in this neighborhood to be close to a concert but it was a great place to walk around! There is a supermarket and a ton of bars and restaurants nearby and I felt safe. The place was clean and comfy--there are multiple units in a divided suite but you have everything you need including a shower that felt great after flying and a nice little kitchen. If you have a rental car you will need to park in a nearby garage but that seems to be the case everywhere.
Great apartment. Ideal for 1-2 traveling and visiting Madrid in the center. Would definitely recommend it. Also Alice is a super nice host, who always answered our questions quickly
Really lovely apartment to stay in, very clean and had everything we needed! Alice also gave excellent and clear instructions and was on hand to help when we needed. Thank you!
I stayed 14 days and there was only two toilet papers also I just asked for 30 minutes late checkout and I really needed that but they strictly refused.

Absolutely lovely! The place was clean beautiful and perfect for a holiday! Madrid streets are so beautiful to walk around! The park was around the corner, great to go in there! Lots of restaurants and really good food! I will stay again! Host was always great and helpful in every way! I 100% recommend this place!

I had an awesome stay at Alice’s! The apartment was very clean, spacious, and secure. Alice was very helpful and responsive with all requests or questions. I give this experience a 5 out of 5 stars! Thank you Alice for letting us stay over!

Stayed here for 3 weeks while I was searching for a place to move to permanently in Madrid. The neighborhood is great - lots of bars and restaurants just around the corner. The area has 3-4 metro stops, connecting you to different lines, so the area is great. The apartment is a bit small, but I guess it's pretty normal for the center of Madrid. It had everything I needed - washing machine, dishwasher, airco and heating working very well, a great shower. The kitchen was pretty well equipped as well, so it was all great. The big tv was also a plus, although you can't directly connect it to Netflix, but you can use an HDMI cable and connect another device. The apartment is on the 6th floor, interior views, which also makes it very quiet. No worries, there's an elevator! Definitely recommend this place.
This Airbnb is such an amazing location, and the check-in process was very smooth. This is outside of the unit's control, but it was a little loud with construction.
Great location in Madrid, host was always very responsive and provided clear instructions. Also place was very well maintained and clean. Would not hesitate to stay there again.
Great apartment in a great location. Emi was a really good host and responded to any questions we had immediately
Large, clean, and in a great location. Awesome stay. The A/C was perfectly adequate even in the middle of the heatwave and everything worked as expected. Would love to stay here again.

Emilio's place was great! Clean, spacious, and close to lots of things. Also had great Metro access. I had a little trouble with the app to get inside — this didn't impact our check-in — but Emilio was very patient and helpful. Checkout was a breeze. The kitchen was clean and supermarkets were right nearby for us to buy what we needed.
Nice and clean apartment, fully equipped. Close to metro. Maria is a great host, communication was always on a timely manner. Easy checking in and out.
Excellent communication with host. Truly appreciate being able to leave bags before check in. Cleanliness was great. Love the safe neighborhood. Overall fantastic experience. We will stay here again
Virginia was a wonderful host and we very much enjoyed the space! Several great restaurants, shops and public transportation in the area.
Great location with a great view. Host is great and very responsive. Bed is very squeeky in the room, needs to be fixed. Hard to fall asleep. Everything else is great. Recommended!

Simple, clean and satisfactory apartment well situated for a short bus or metro ride into the city centre. As two friends, we really appreciated not only our own bedrooms but also our own bathrooms making our stay really practical. Merci Maria José.
Dans place in Madrid was perfect! Check in was extremely easy and efficient and his extra efforts towards amenities did not go unnoticed!

Clean & functional Airbnb Kitchen appliances were new and bathroom was really nice. Studio apartment, train station and supermarket nearby. Dot cafe on the street was great Additional cleaning and service fees were a little pricey

This place was the best Airbnb I’ve ever been too! I loved the area. There was a Mercado around the corner and I didn’t see any tourists but it had great restaurants and all You would Need. There are also metro stations and scooters a couple blocks away, with a fifteen minute commute to the center of things. Roni was a wonderful Hostess and communicated quickly and recommended restaurants and even a masseuse . The apartment is gorgeous with her original Artwork all around making you feel like you are in a museum while Also having the feel Of a well Loved place where you can relax on comfortable couches, beds and a balcony. There was cross ventilation , quiet and even a bathtub with a window on top Of it. I can’t recommend this place enough. I would definitely get this space again the next time I am in Madrid !

We just finished a 5 night stay at Roni's place and absolutely loved everything about it. The location is ideal, in the heart of Chamberi, with coffee shops, bakeries, supermarkets, and restaurants (including the must try Peppe Fusco) all within a short walk. The place itself has a wonderful open air feel to it, with a loft (that my teenage daughter loved), and outdoor rooftop patio that we spent all of our mornings and late evenings. The place is probably ideally suited to either a couple of a family with smaller children.

Roni’s place was absolutely lovely and was in an excellent location. Roni was very responsive. We had a bit of a challenge getting into the apartment, as it seemed like Evelyn (the person who met us) couldn’t hear the buzzer and took a while to come downstairs to let us in (we had to ask Roni a few times to tell her to come down). The place was accurately described and beautifully decorated, with lots of Roni’s own art on display. There is some room for improvement in terms of the cleanliness, but overall it was alright. Would definitely stay there again.

We had a wonderful 5 night stay at the flat and would definitely stay again / recommend. The flat had everything we possibly needed. It was slightly more open plan than expected but was still cosy and very spacious for 3 people. Roni was very responsive and lovely to speak to, making the whole trip very easy :)

This place is an absolute gem! Right in the centre of one of the city’s most popular and most beautiful districts with great transport links. The apartment is stylish and impeccably clean and Jose made us feel incredibly welcome. Would recommend tenfold!

Everything functioned well! It was very pleasant that Jose met us in person even if we arrived at 1 am. Communication was good and Jose’s place was very freshly decorated and furnished. The location is very central and there are tons of restaurants close by. I can recommend this Airbnb for other couple travellers.
Nice apartment in a great area. It’s a very turbulent street with bars which can give a lot of noise during the night.

The house was very compact and convenient. The shopping center and train station was near us and we had a really nice stay there. One thing can be the outside can be loud at night time and it’s scary go out late night. Though, the host was really nice and she took care of us well. I recommend it to friends group who is planning to travel Madrid.

The apartment is absolutely perfect. The location is superb, the apartment is big and very well equipped. We could walk to all main attractions and the public transport is two step away. Marta is a great host. Communication could not be easier. Would love to come back.

What a great find! Perfect location, restaurants,bars and museums were all within walking distance. Fabulous apartment, very true to the photos with tasteful decor. It was very comfortable and well equipped, we had everything we needed. Marta was a very good communicator and welcomed us warmly and answered our questions promptly. She sent clear instructions and entrance was very easy. Would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was as described and the neighborhood was actually nicer than we expected. Lots of good places within walking distance and very well-connected. Gaby was also flexible with the check-in time, which was very helpful.

We had a great time here, it was perfectly located for us, close to the metro and easy to navigate. The host was helpful from start to finish and we couldn't have asked for more really! I travelled with two others and we have all said how good it was! Very happy we booked this place

The communication was very easy and courteous, same as check in. Location is great - you can reach every important sight by foot, but still it is very quiet. Furniture and decoration is chosen with love for detail, great vibe and energy of the apartment and a very comfortable bed, you can really calm down, relax and get your rest in this flat!
Needed a spot just for one night and this was a great spot. Clean, good price, good location. Check in is pretty easy once you download the app.
Amazing host. Was a very enjoyable experience and she was super nice and responsive to all of my needs.

Emilio's place is right at the Plaza de España, PRIME location. The apartment is compact yet with everything. We requested a stay on the same date of arrival of Madrid during holiday season. Emi responded super quickly and was able to clean/prepare the apartment very nicely on time. His communication is very quick and efficient. Loved the stay and could recommend to singles or couples!
Very great apartment with a stunning view over Madrid from the balcony. Everything important was available and the owners are available 24/7. Thanks for that!
