The apartment is in the best location. I’ve been to Madrid before and this is the best location. Perfect for two to three people. Walking distance to all of the places you must see in Madrid! Pablo and Endry are very responsive and ready to answer any questions. Thank you for everything!

Comfortable, clean, and in a great location! The bathroom is very small and doesn’t offer much privacy as it has a sliding frosted glass door, but if you’re comfortable with that, it’s a great value for the location.
Lily was an excellent host. She was very responsive and flexible. The apartment is charming and the location is priceless. Walk to three major museums and to the center of town.

Great place, very comfortable and homey, good existing character with a nicely designed fitout and a well curated mix of interesting furniture, art, objects, books etc all in a fantastic location. Loved it.

This is probably one of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in. Hosted in a 19th apartment in an historic neighborhood, just across a convent. But with a wonderfully beautiful modern update. The layout feels so cozy, making it filled with light and warm. Very thoughtful and well designed without being cheesy or driven by how it will look in photos. And I just loved the neighborhood. Streets filled with history, and super central if you want to just walk around Madrid. And to top it off, the hosts went above and beyond: they provided us with a blender right as we were arriving, and were extremely accommodating and helpful. I’m surprised I noticed it’s rare these days to have a personal touch with the hosts. They were super warm.

A really lovely apartment right in the heart of Las Letras - there is even a quotation from Fuenteovejuna right outside the door in the pavement! I loved the art and the furniture in the apartment and it has a good size kitchen and eating area. A great centre for a cultural and foodie break in Madrid.

This is a wonderful apartment and wonderful hosts. Everything was easy and we really appreciated having such a comfortable and beautiful refuge during a very hot week in Madrid. Would stay here again for sure.

Great place, nice neighbourhood, walking distance from major museums & parks, bars & restaurants, welcoming & responsive hosts, well appointed, friendly vibe, good daylight & fresh air, feels like living in Madrid!

Raul apartment is in a great location, walking distance to Madrid main attractions. The apartment is well kept with high speed internet WiFi, A/C and a small balcony. We will recommend this apartment to our friends and family.

The apartment was super clean, specially the rooms and the bathrooms (the most important parts). It has 3 small balconies which is always nice to have some fresh air. The location is probably the best part, amazing location. If I’m ever in Madrid I’ll stay here again for sure!

Easy access location close to most points of interest in Madrid. The room and bathroom are as advertised in the pictures, clean and furbished/designed with contemporary taste. Would recommend for shorter stays (i.e. 2-3 days) rather than week-long holidays. The front desk team is very friendly and helpful. A complementary storage service for luggage is available prior/post check-in.

The room was exactly as pictured, clean and perfect for my stay. No complaints about that at all. They also provide a locker if you need to leave your stuff after checking in which is great. I would def stay here again. Only thing was that, I wasn't able to get in to the building because the door code was not working and it was late at night. I contacted the number that was provided and no one got back to me until the next day. I was only able to get in because someone else came from the inside and opened the door. It would be great to have someone available to help 24/7. If the door was working, checkin would have been 5 stars! They have fixed it since.
Don’t hesitate to book here. It’s a perfect room, very clean and comfortable. Easy check in. Perfect location. Everything was amazing.
Good location to acssess main spots. The bed and bedding were fantastic. Host is very kind and i really enjoyed staying except noise until dawn and no refrigerator.

Alfonso’s apartment was perfect for our group. The location was excellent and the apartment very clean, comfortable and well laid out. We couldn’t have had a better location for a wonderful stay in Madrid. Thank you!
Great location! Nearby to attractions and shoppings. So quiet for a 10th floor property with breath taking view. Recommend for everyone to visit Madrid!

This is a very nice apartment, well furnished and with a spectacular view. Great location for visiting the city. The host was kind and accommodating, with a quick response to everything we needed. Highly recommended.

Alfonso was a great host. He met us upon arrival and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay. The apartment was great - beds were comfortable and we had everything we needed. The location was great - very walkable. I would highly recommend and I look forward to my next stay!

We had a fantastic stay at this centrally located Airbnb in Madrid. The apartment was spotless, with everything we needed, including a washer and dryer, which was a huge plus for our family. The host was incredibly responsive and welcoming, and the check-in and orientation were seamless. We were able to walk everywhere from this ideal location, and the view from the bedrooms was absolutely beautiful. It was the perfect home base for exploring the city. We highly recommend it. Wonderful hospitality all around. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful apartment. The location was perfect, our host was communicative, the apartment was spotless (and totally charming with lots of whimsy!), and the rooftop deck an oasis. We’d definitely return.

The balcony is the highlight of this property! I also loved the vibe and decor. Alicia was very responsive & when we had a plumbing issue (common with a historic building), she was very helpful. The apartment is bright with great natural lighting. The location is good for walking to most typical tourist spots. It was actually surprisingly quiet for sleeping given being in the city. We enjoyed the apartment and would recommend.

Beautiful place in an amazing location, walking distance from restaurants, bars & sight seeing. We had difficulty figuring out how to use the keys but Raul always answered the phone immediately and was a huge help! Would definitely stay here again
Great apartment in a lively neighborhood. Walkable to metro, plus many restaurants and shops. Would rent again.

Raul’s apartment is in a super spot in Malasana. The place was clean and spacious and Raul was a responsive host. We would definitely stay again. Plaza de Olavide 10 minutes away is a gorgeous oval with plenty of bars and restaurants to choose from and enjoy a tinto de verano.
Raul's place is very well located in the center of Madrid, with tons of restaurants and activity around. The place was quiet and as in the photos. Raul was very responsive and friendly!

Place is nice. Frustrated that we were offered early check in, we made plans accordingly, then early check in was taken away. Frustrated no detergent, no paper towels and only two sets of keys when it’s a four bedroom unit. Great location. Very nice place. A few small things would have to change to stay there again.
Huge space where 8 people can comfortably sleep, the service and the location was amazing, neighborhood has many delicious restaruants
We have a wonderful stay! Great location and walkable to many things. Would stay again for sure.
This apartment was clean, a perfect size, and in a great location. I had a wonderful time staying here.
This was a great stay! Very close to the metro line 2 with plenty of restaurants around for local eating. Place was clean, quiet and secure :)
Great accommodation, very clean and Rayo Vallecano stadium and Metro station is right in front of the accommodation

We loved the place, it's spacious, well-located, with good links to the main parts of the city and it's relatively quiet neighborhood. They were quite flexible with check-in and check-out times as well. We'll be using Olala next time we're in Madrid.
It was very clean and I liked the Tv and the neighbourhood that was in and around it, really good.

The apartment was amazing, close to everything g and it has a metro station next to it. It was clean, modern and beautiful. Communication was great! They even let us leave our bags somewhere else until check in time! Definitely recommend!!!!
Elena is very kind and helpful, we couldn't have asked for a better host. Her place is very clean, it has everything you need for a short or long stay. The shower is amazing.

We had a great time at Maria's place. We were traveling with a one year old and it was the perfect place to stay. The apartment was very clean and had MORE than enough to make our stay as comfortable as possible.

Lovely, comfortable apartment, spotlessly clean. Hosts were very kind, helpful and responsive. Excellent location, close to shops and metro, and I felt very safe. The kitchen had everything I needed to cook my meals. I highly recommend and I hope to stay there again soon! Many thanks to the hosts for a wonderful stay!

Lourdes, Roque, and Luke hosted us in this outstanding Madrid apartment. We stayed for a month and loved every minute. The apartment is very comfortable, and the appliances and fittings are excellent. It was helpful to have two full bathrooms, a rarity with one-bedroom apartments. The location is superb, close to Plaza Mayor and Puerta del Sol, easy distance to the Museum mile, El Retiro Park (great for running), Palacio Real, and even the Madrid Rio. We walked everywhere. The food scene in Madrid (and near the apartment) is incredible. We enjoyed visiting and buying groceries and produce at Anton Martin and went to most of the restaurant recommendations our hosts suggested. Their suggestions are excellent. We really can't say enough good things about this place. It would be our first choice for our next Madrid stay. We recommend it without any hesitation.
Really nice location, the host was so nice and it is perfect for staying a weekend in Madrid.
The place was too small and the furniture didnt fit the size of the room. One’s could hardly walk. Felt very uncomfortable.

Lovely studio apt/room with hotel like amenities. A bit smaller than the picture but had everything and quite comfortable. Great central location. Very clean. Courteous and cooperative host. Overall highly recommended for 1-2 guests with less luggage.
Cozy, clean, and central stay! Viviana was an excellent host! She was extremely responsive and accommodating!

Our stay was great! Viviana’s place was clean, walkable, and exactly as described. She was responsive, provided instruction as needed, and helped us store our bags a little after check-out on our last day. Definitely recommend.

This place is perfectly located in the heart of Madrid, next to Plaza Mayor and some fantastic local spots! Viviana is super responsive and easy to communicate with. All in all, it's a fantastic choice for your next visit to Madrid!
Very spacious. Great location. It had every thing we needed. We messaged Marcos to get sheets for the sofa bed and he responded right away. We will stay there again.

Spacious apartment, felt right at home. Location was outside of the main tourist attractions but totally walkable to them but with a more local feel. Only thing was 2 of the heaters didn’t work, but the apartment had enough of extra blankets. Apartment felt clean - bathroom, kitchen, linen. Would stay again.

Lovely, clean, spacious apartment in a fabulous, central area! Everything is in walking distance. The best market in Madrid Saint Michael Market (Mercado de San Miguel) is basically on your doorstep, along with the Plaza Mayor. Host were every attentive and could ask anything at anytime! Would recommend 10/10.

Pros : 1. The apartment is in a great location! 2. Building has an elevator 3. Easy check in through a web app 4. Apartment is cutely decorated Cons: 1. Found a few cockroaches in the house during our stay. 2. No blanket available initially when I arrived. This was immediately given when I brought it to their attention. 3. The double bed is a bit small for 2 people . The cons can easily be ignored because our experience in this apartment was good. If these small things can be worked out , this stay is a easy 5 stars 🌟
The apartment is very clean and tidy. Host is also very responsive and helpful. The location is also very good and in close distance from subway station.
We had a great stay at Ivan's place. very nice apartment, exactly like the pictures. Location was excelent too. We will definitely stay again there when back to Madrid.
I came to Madrid for the gay pride and Ivan’s apartment has the best location with easy access to Gran Via and public transportation. On top of it Ivan was responsive and was always willing to help.

We had a great stay at Oscar's apartment. Perfect location, right in the city center and walking distance from most of the places we wanted to visit. The place is super clean and the communication with the host was very smooth. I will certainly stay there again at my next visit to Madrid!

Great place, and ideal location! You can walk around everywhere in the city center and there's a 24h supermarket right in front. The apartment is comfy, very stylish and clean. And you don't hear noises from the street - the door to the little terrace is pretty soundproof. Super responsive and helpful host. Would definitely stay here again.
This is the best location you could ask for! Right in the middle of Madrid, where all the action is. The apartment was very quiet. The host was great at communicating. I would stay here again!

Had a great weekend break. The Apartment was very clean and just as the pictures suggested. Was in a great location to explore the city from. Oscar was extremely helpful, responsive and gave some very good recommendations on where to eat. Highly recommend
A short stay but very worth it. Oscar and the team were very helpful. In a spot in Madrid. Highly recommend!

Oscar is such a great host. From greeting us upon arrival, to local restaurant recommendations. He is super friendly, and responds quickly if you ever have any questions. Located at the city center of Madrid! Highly recommend staying here!

We were fortunate enough to find Fernando’s place. You can’t beat the location, it was fantastic. Even though it was on a busy pedestrian street it was very quiet. The communication from our host was excellent. Walking distance to everything but still a short distance from the metro. Highly recommend.
Perfect location for a few days exploring Madrid. We could walk everywhere and easy access to the metro. Apartment was clean and as shown in pictures. We really enjoyed our stay!
Nice clean place in the middle of Madrid central city. Felt safe and had a great view of the city. Little hard to locate at first but once we found it was quite lovely.
Beautiful location and such a friendly check in! Also right above the best pizza place in the world. Loved staying in the heart of everything.

Great stay. Fernando and Maria are wonderful hosts, very friendly and accommodating. Provided local tips for restaurants and sites. Apartment is clean and comfortable. It is centrally located near Gran Via and Sol with lots to do yet quiet at night for sleeping. Will come back!!
we stayed there for 2 days. the location is very good. lots of restaurants around there. the hoster is very helpful.
The apartment had that cool city vibe. Close to shopping and some site seeing. Also close to where you can grab a taxi to go other places in the city.

This stay was amazing, one of my favorites. The location was wonderful. Bielka was one of the most accommodating hosts i’ve ever stayed with and was very communicative and helpful the entire time (even coming to help when I accidentally locked myself out of the apartment and giving us a fan for the heat). 100% the best stay you can book in Madrid. Completely wonderful stay in a beautiful and clean apartment.
Great location and great place to stay. Communication with the host was fluid and accurate. Recommendations...

The location was great, walkable to Sol and Gran Via. We even walked to Atocha with our bags: 30 minutes or so but downhill! We liked the blackout blinds and air conditioning, so we slept well, too. Great place!

Great and clean space for a stay in Madrid! Pedro was very responsive and checked me in personally - the place is well equipped and I loved how cool it stays in summer without the AC! I would come back and stay again - loved it :) thanks Pedro! 🙂
Loved this apartment. Perfect location. Very spacious and up to date. Hosts were outstanding - very responsive and flexible. Highly recommended

This place is really nice as an apartment and very quiet for the location. Host was very responsive and overall, was an amazing place to stay. However, we did find ourselves in restaurants and situations where it was clear, tourists were not welcome. Especially American tourists. The first night we were in Madrid, there was a Pro-Palastine rally where they were chanting anti American chants.
Great apartment with walkable distances to lots of attractions such as Royal Palace, park Madrid and Basilica and many restaurants. Highly recommend.
Perfect location, very close to a lot of cozy squares. The apartment itself was amazing, with a lovely balkony.

Great location, nice apartment! Most of the touristic spots are from a walking distance, which makes everything easier. Check in might seem complicated (you have to download an app) but is actually easy, just make sure you have battery and internet on your phone!

MIT house is extremely convenient for those wanting to explore old Madrid by foot. We spent 3 days exploring the Royal Palace, Gardens, Cathedrals. Plaza Mayor is an extremely convenient 10 min walk where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner. Coupled with the nearby Mercado San Miguel, we never even got close to sampling half the culinary delights it had to offer.

This apartment is wonderful and in one of the best and most local spots in Madrid's city center. It has a lot of space, very comfortable, and easy access with the app. The host was very responsive. Walking distance to the museums, but not touristy. Would definitely come back!
We had a great stay in Daniel’s apartment, which is stylish, well-equipped and spotless clean. The location is perfect with lots of cozy bars, shops and restaurants. We can definitely recommend it!

Thank you. The apartment is great, nicely decorated, very clean. It has everything you need. The apartment’s windows face inner yard, you don’t hear the noice from the street, although you can hear all the neighbours very well:) (watching the tv, talking…)
A very clean and well laid out apartment in a central and walkable area. Electronic key works well just make sure you read the instructions and check in prior to arrival.
Super cute, clean place with comfortable bed. Well located and cool neighborhood. Host was very communicative and check in was easy.

Thank you so much for being a great host, the stay was phenomenal and the place was even nicer than we imagined. Everything was great, communication was great and the place is so clean and beautiful! Walking distance to everywhere you want to go in Madrid
The place was perfect for our stay. Very satisfied with the apartment, very clean and owner has great communication.

The apartment is beautifully renovated and located, but unfortunately has an extremely unpleasant and overwhelming smell. Additionally, during our stay the water was shut off completely for multiple days and the host told me they had no connections to the building and had no insight to offer me.
It was ok. Quite small place. I would remove the description saying that there is oil, salt and pepper in the kitchen. I had a problem with the shower and all the water went out everywhere

Antonio's place was perfect for my husband and I on an 8-day visit to Madrid. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go, plus it's surrounded by great food and shopping. The bed was comfortable and the kitchenette had everything we needed to make breakfast and light dinners.

Great place, walking distance to many beautiful parts of Madrid - restaurants and cafes. Colòn Metro only a 5 minutes walk, well connected to transports. The only down side if you are a light sleeper is the club downstairs than attracts noisy crowds throughout the night queuing under the window.

Perfect place to stay in Madrid. Close to everything and walking distance to most sights. Close to all necessary transport links. Check in was seamless and the place had everything you could need. Very impressed. Would and will stay again!
Great place located walking distance from the city Center. The place is great, just as shown in the pictures. I’d like to thank Ana for being a great host and her hospitality.

This was an awesome Airbnb stay! Just was very communicative! It was nice having an elevator for luggage. Nice and clean! Location was great! Check in was easy. They allowed me to store my luggage which was helpful as we were flying out. I would highly recommend and would stay here again!!!

The place was very clean maybe too clean, the smell of bleach was a bit overpowering when first entering :) Very functional and extremely well located, very close to the Pallazio. Decoration is a bit unpersonal, very AIrBnB cliché with lots of frames with messages in the kitchen, even the "But First Coffee" sign (see Family Guy S21E17). It was perfect for our family stay of 3 persons (1 adult and 2 kids)

Nice place, very clean! However co host stopped responding after about 3 days of being here. Simply asked for a barber recommendation! Also said thank you for letting us stay and that I’ve done the checkout steps and got left on read. Other than that the place is perfect to stay ! Clean and cozy. The mini split in the living room didn’t work however, it was very cold in there.
Would stay here again! Great area, AC works perfect, nice size. Very responsive and helpful host.

Our first time in Madrid, the place and location were PERFECT! Very safe neighborhood and we enjoyed how walkable it was. Restaurants, shops, grocery stores, bars, gyms, etc., everything is accessible. The place itself was nicely furnished and had more than enough room for all 4.5 of us. Very clean and matched pictures. Host was amazing and very proactive. We would definitely use again and if available, we highly recommend you book it!
Nice flat with all practical amenities. Located in the heart of Lavapies, with no shortage of great places to eat and drink nearby. Easy check-in and check-out, and clear communication.

Great apartment in the Lavapies district of Madrid so lots of restaurants, bars culture and entertainment to chose from. Apartment was very clean and well equipped and communication with the host was easy and quick. Would happily return - highly recommended.
Overall great stay but I would say the neighbourhood is quite residential and not too much around. perfect for me as I had meetings nearby. Host was very responsive and helpful

good location, 2 m walk to metro, 10 m walk to plaza mayor, many markets and fast food places close by, room is as in the picture maybe a bit smaller,well cleaned, smart tv, hot water available at all times, no surprises. Jorge responded to our few messages immidiately. A few minor details would make it great.
Perfect location at the centre of Madrid. Easy check in and good communication. The accomodation is very accurate.

The homey apartment is right in the middle of a bustling area full of stores, cafes, restaurants, bars, and clubs, yet is surprisingly quiet. It had everything I needed, was easy to access, and immediately felt like a home away from home. It is in the middle of the LGBTQ+ area of town, which was a bonus for me. The self check-in was extremely convenient, and Orlando was very quick to respond and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.
Great location!! Walking distance to many interest points around the city, coffee and food very convenient downstairs, safe area, perfect for chilling around the city centre.
Everything was great! Laura is very responsive and helpful! Loved her place and will absolutely come back! Thanks!
The apartment is in the very center of Madrid: you can easily reach all most famous spots. The communication with the host is fast and I’ve got all the info that I need…
Apartment was really clean and just as advertised. Location was really central and convenient. Enjoyed our stay.
Central location, spacious apartment. Only AC in the living area, one bedroom without window. Small shower and a bit dated. If you don’t mind that and mainly care about location; go for it
the appt is in the city centre. perfect if you are visiting madrid. Everything is at a walking distance. Will surely consider it again.

The house was wonderful. Very well appointed and clean. Belen was a terrific, responsive host. The home exceeded expectations and was an excellent base for our trip to Madrid. Highly recommend!! Thank you Belen, for a lovely stay.
The place is so cute, location amazing can’t be better, 😢 the only problem is not elevator and is in the 3rd floor.
Thank you. The apartment feels brand new and is in the perfect location for a tourist visit. Thank you!

Host was very responsive and accommodating with letting us leave our luggage before check in. Location was great and easy to find. Only thing that I would say is that the beds and pillows are both extremely uncomfortable and to bring your own paper towels and toilet paper as there was nothing in the apartment other than 1 roll of toilet paper on 4 guests. The WiFi was also not the best. Otherwise we enjoyed our stay
Great apartment. We had trouble connecting to the internet but the problem was addressed and fixed within 24 hours.
Perfectly clean, well equipped and with a great living space, the apartment is just of the Mayor and for those who want to be in the heart of the bustle old Madrid.
Great location right off plaza mayor, walkable to the palace and prado museum. The apartment looks just like the pictures, and was very clean.

Botoneras is a fantastic place to stay for a small family. The location is central, accessible to all major attractions, and nearby to many delicious restaurants. The employee is friendly and responsive to our questions.
Great place overall, really ideal and lose to the center, reccomended for family trip.
It was amazing, located in the center of everything! Had shops, food, drinks 5-10 minutes away walking. As well as a beautiful view. Definitely worth staying here!

Great deal and Nicolás is a very friendly man. This place is very clean and spacious. The shower runs out of hot water a bit quick but no complaints other than that. Great balcony and great area for bars, clubs, and sooo many restaurants.
The host was really nice and available. The apartment is well kept and the location is really good. I recommend it.

All great for the price paid, considerably above expectations. Apartment size is good for 2 people, amazing location in Chueca, all really great. Nicolas is responsive at all times and that is also really important
gorgeous views from the studio along with a very nice and kind host ready to help out!
Best location, great design. I would definitely be staying again in this beautiful apartment with great hosts.

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very clean, beautifully decorated and very easy to check in. So much to do in the area. We had to contact Javier about a few questions and he was very responsive. It was a bonus that there are 2 full bathrooms. The waterfall shower was nice and the water pressure was amazing. We would highly recommend this air bnb!
This is a great place, in the best location, and the host was helpful and quick to respond to text messages. Highly recommended!

The flat was greatly located and the hosts were always very responsive. We were allowed to do an early check in and then they held or bags for us after check out until we were ready to go to the airport. Highly recommendable!!

Very comfortable place. It has all you need to stay a few days. Good Airconditioning, great shower, complete kitchen. Modern and practical apartment. Location Is very central, with many restaurants, bars, shopping, metro, bus, etc.

Great apartment with beautiful renovations and upgrades! The bathroom was clean and had soap and shampoo for us to use. The sofa bed was also already set-up for us with clean sheets upon arrival which was very helpful. Great location, easy check-in process. Would stay here again.
Beautiful apartment in an amazing location. Extremely responsive to any question you may have and somewhere I would love to stay again.

Beautiful & spacious apartment in the heart of Madrid! It was just perfect for a long weekend with friends. The host is super helpful, even we when we forgot the house key at 5am, they helped right away. Highly recommend!

The apartment was centrally located with lots to do at every hour of the day. It had a great view of Plaza Mayor and is right next to El Mercado, which has great Tapas. The house is on the “4th floor” but it’s really on three 6th or 7th floor. There are shops underneath the building and those floors aren’t counted. It was a mission to get up the 4th floor, but we made it fun. If you have trouble going up stairs, this is definitely not a place for you.

Thank you for a beautiful stay right off Plaza Mayor. In the middle of all of the action. Very responsive host when we had a heating issue and door knob issue. People were sent within the hour. Spotless and very spacious apartment. As mentioned there were numerous flights of stairs, which were fine for us, but might be an issue with others. Lots of bars and restaurants right outside the door.
Great little apartment for a couple , in a really cool part of Madrid but you can’t hear it from the place

Excellent clean and modern renovated place within an older historical building. The bed rise to the ceiling and you can pull it down for the night. The washroom is well equipped with great hairdryer, various amenities and even tissues and q-tips.
We had a great stay. Tania and Maria were so kind and the apartment was ideal for two people wanting to explore the city! We would definitely come back again :)

Stayed at Tanias place for 4 nights and we had an absolutely amazing stay. Everything from check-in to check-out was fantastic. The apartment had everything and more that we needed - including a stocked fridge/cupboards/ and fresh fruit for us! It was an amazing stay for two of us, very cozy and in a great location walking distance to so many things. Couldn’t have been happier and would love to stay again if we come back to Madrid!

This was the perfect spot in Madrid - such a cute and safe neighbourhood with thrift shops and restaurants- walking distance to so many tourist attracts and close to a metro stop which made arriving from the airport so easy :) so clean and modern would definitely stay again!

Cecilia’s place is clean and spacious. The perfect location. The room has everything you needed for a short stay visit. Cecilia is an excellent host, responds to the messages right away and explains in details the directions to the apartment. I did not meet Cecilia, her daughter greeted us upon arrival, very nice and polite young woman. Gave us direction to the city and explained the apartment. Would come again.

Excellent experience all around. Incrediby central location for Madrid visitors with easy access to public transportation. The apartment was quite comfortable with a fully appointed kitchen as well as a squeaky clean bathroom. The owner was very friendly and helpful and gave me some of his local recommendations for grocery shopping, restaurants and bars. Even though the location may appear vibrant in a somewhat dense neighborhood, the interior orientation of the apartment proved to be very serene and quiet and made for perfect sleeping. Highly recommended.

We had a good stay at Beky's place. Couple of young kids came to meet us and showed us in. They were very sweet. When we asked for an extra set of keys, they were immediately dropped off. I guess the only thing that we didn't realise that there were no windows out onto the street, they were all internal windows onto light wells. Having said that, there was enough light coming in and the apartment was quiet. Metro was only a short walk away.

Marco has the right balance of support and respecting your privacy. He is willing work with you to solve any issues that might arise and quick to provide support when you do have a request to make … not that you have to much of a need to anyways. The app was a great tool for navigating the apartment and surroundings and his description of the apartment was flawless and apt. My family had a great experience with this spot and we plan to be back soon. Thanks Marco

This was a very nice apartment at a reasonable price. We had 4 people in the unit and it was perfect. It's within walking distance to the metro and there is a grocery store nearby. The apartment was very clean and the amenities were as advertised, 10/10 would recommend.

The apartment and the building itself is very new. It was clean and perfect fit for 2 persons. The wifi works perfectly fine. There is a supermarket 3 minutes from the apartment. But the apartment is 10 minutes away from metro station. If you understand spanish, it will be easier for you to communicate. But Esther is very kind and response very quickly.

A great apartment. Was very clean and well maintained. Bathrooms and rooms as described. Plenty of space. Many beds so great for a large family with kids or two families staying together. Great location with metro access within a block or two of walking. Several markets and restaurants right nearby. Air condition worked very well. Would absolutely stay there again if we were in Madrid.
Fantastic stay. Excellent host and flexible check in. The location could not be in a better spot in Malasaña.

We had originally booked another home but when we arrived in Madrid, the host stopped responding. We were stuck at the airport with no place to go and exhausted. I contacted various hosts. Emilio was amazing. He responded quickly and allowed us to check in earlier. The home was centrally located… within walking distance to everything…which was perfect. The only issue was that the property is in front of a bar and people hung outside drinking and eating until late hours of the night. Thank you, Emilio!!!

We enjoyed our stay. We would have liked advance notice of the enormous hole in the ceiling which we were told would be fixed during our stay which it wasn’t, but though it was very ugly, it didn’t affect our stay. The kitchen was poorly equipped and tired but we were happy that utensils were brought over to us when we requested them. The beds were extremely comfortable and the location was excellent though. Overall a good place to stay
Great location, clean apartment of decent size. Javier is very responsive in answering questions, and the instructions for checkin is clear. Great experience, highly recommended!
Very clean in a great neighborhood of Madrid. The hosts are responsive and allowed us to check-in early after a morning flight into the city.
This was an amazing stay! I was located in the perfect location, right next to the metro exit and in a perfect location to easily walk to all main attractions. Would definitely stay again!
The apartment was clean and as described and shown in photos. Well equipped kitchen incl toaster and kettle, and bathroom was modern with a good hairdryer. Good value for money in a great location.
The apartment was super cute and the neighborhood was near everything. They were also very accommodating with check-in/check-out! Highly recommended!
The apartment is spacious for living area. The location is very walkable to restaurants & shopping & historic sites.

Great place in a great location! Kike was super helpful and considerate. Really appreciated the complimentary snacks, treats and fully stocked fridge with the essentials. Would recommend to anyone thinking of staying in Madrid and would definitely stay here again.
The place was very clean. It has lots of extras around the apartment including the kitchen area and the bathroom.

Very proactive and friendly host! Always available for answering questions and doubts. Got the cleaning done also in the middle of the stay. The location is great, very central. The road is narrow and does not let the apartment becoming too hot: I only turned on the A/C when Madrid was hitting 37-38 C! The only (known) downside was the smell of smoke which lasted even though the house has two air purifiers.

This a really beautiful and comfortable place to stay, and looks exactly like the pictures! The flat is spotlessly clean, and has everything you need - good water pressure in the shower, and great lighting. The area is lovely and you're close to lots of lovely restaurants, bars and vintage shops. Because it's an interior apartment it's still very quiet which is really nice, considering where it is. My hosts were really accommodating and flexible and I would definitely stay again!

The location is the best, it is also very close to metro tribunal, the apartment is renovated, comfortable and clean. Check in was easy. I really recommend it. The 2 windows faces the patio, there is not much light coming from outside but you will be out all day in Madrid :)

Honest summary of the stay: - Amazing location/downtown, 5min walk to everything. - Looks exactly like the pictures, no surprises. - Was clean and very well kept, incl towels and sheets. - Iron, washing machine and all other appliances were working perfectly. - Check in/out was very smooth and flexible. (+/- 1hour) - Owners are lovely, spoke English & Spanish, were very helpful and attentive. - Neighboors are sweet and polite. - Very calm at night, no busy street and noises. Highly recommended for a hassle free, hotel-like experience. Will 100% book the same exact Airbnb next time i visit, wouldn't have it any other way! Thank you guys for the lovely stay <33

Wonderful place in a great neighborhood. Loved staying here. only challenge was the room door had no key and it was a new experience for me. All in all Nelli assured me of safety and I got it. plus the house has cameras. Also if you have a lot or a heavy luggage, take note in advance that there is no elevator currently, the house is in the 3rd floor.

Overall had a great stay here. The location is hard to beat, and the apartment is a good size. There were linens and towels provided, which was really convenient. Kitchen is small but has everything you need. At one point I had an issue with the wifi, and the host was helpful with troubleshooting.
I was there for five days and since I was looking for a place to crash after coming back from the office, it was perfect for me. Very clean and quiet, couldn't ask for more. Thank you very much!
Great flat, very well appointed. Location is amazing, the neighbourhood is truly a jewel Javier was welcoming and helpful, I would fully recommend this property

Javiers flat was the perfect place to stay. The neighbourhood is so vibrant and with the flat facing the way it is - we had a quiet and peaceful space in the centre of lavapies and the city. Lavapies was such a fun neighbourhood to stay in with so many bars and places to eat - we loved it. The flat was clean and comfortable and a perfect space for 2. There’s also a 24 hour supermarket just a min away and very well connected to trains metros and buses would definitely recommend 10/10

Javier's house is super nice, it's clean, prettily decorated and has all the things we want. It's quite suitable for two people as it has two bedrooms. Moreover, it's close to railway station and most attractions, the location is perfect to explore the city. i would definitely choose Javier's house again next time.

This property is in a perfect location, close to the center and walking distance to several places. The street has the cutest bars and a delicious Brunch spot. The flat was clean and very comfortable. The flat is on the 4th floor with an elevator, no air condition but with the windows open the flat remains cool. Be prepared to eat all of your meals out as the kitchen is not very well equipped with plates. Overall great experience and would definitely stay here again.
Great place with a great location. Host can be a little unresponsive and hard to get a hold of but it was never a major issue.
The flat is immaculate, well designed and nicely furnished. The beds were very comfortable, kitchen well stocked and the location was ideal. I highly recommend the flat without any reservation.

You don't need to think twice about booking this awesome apartment. Even my local friends recommend this beautiful home :) This apartment is located near cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, tourist attractions etc (I never once took the train or bus!). It was so clean, had everything I needed and I was sad when it was time to leave. Ammar was an amazing host, definitely 1 of the best hosts I've ever met! He was so accommodative (waiting for us when we missed our check in timing and allowing us to leave our luggages behind after checking out), always there whenever we needed him, and so ever patient :) Thank you so much for making our Madrid trip a beautiful and memorable one Ammar!
Ammar went out of his way to provide directions and meet us at his apartment. He explained all the features of the apartment completely. Wonderful host and apartment - thank you Ammar!

Ammar was such an incredible host-friendly, very responsive and super helpful with recommendations for the area! I loved his apartment-it was spotless, check-in was easy and Ammar was flexible with check-in time which I greatly appreciated. I felt right at home and loved the small touches such as the welcome chocolates; I only wish I had stayed there longer! This was by far one of my best Airbnb experiences. The apartment is located in a fantastic neighborhood with lots of great restaurants, in walking distance from the major sights. I would definitely stay here for a future trip!
Clean and calm apartment in a great location. Ammar was very communicative and had great recommendations. Would stay here again!

Ammar was a wonderful host. He met us personally and showed us around the apartment, he provided excellent suggestions for restaurants and activities, plus a delightful bottle of wine on arrival. This apartment is located within easy walking distance of hundreds of wonderful restaurants, lots of grocery stores and many of the historic sites of Madrid. The local transit system was excellent and easily accessible. This was a wonderful location for Madrid sightseeing.

Good location with many restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets in walking distance. Metro station is just 5 min walk. Water pressure from the shower is not strong enough and hot water will run out quickly. Better to wait 30 min for the 2nd person to take shower.

We were staying for 3 nights before Boom festival, and the apartment was perfect for our needs, the area is a bit far from the center but very nice and we didn’t miss anything by being a bit far, we actually preferred it. :)

Amazing location! You should know a few things about this listing: people are in and out as there will be other guests. They may come home at 5am from partying and they may be loud :) Our room with the window smelled like smoke. this is hard to avoid because people in the complex blow smoke out of their windows and if the window is open, it will smell like smoke. when we arrived and the whole stay our room smelled of smoke. Those were the cons, everything else about this place: great location, great host and communication, affordable, and again, a great location!! Thank you Daniel and Marlon!

Great apartment, newly renovated, modern, quiet and clean. The host was awesome, with great recommendations for area restaurants. The location is ideal, near the metro and near many restaurants. The neighbourhood is residential with groceries close by, including two fruit shops on the same block. There’s also a park nearby where families and people with their dogs gather. I very much recommend Ignacio’s place and the neighbourhood! Retiro park is a few metro stops away as are the tourist areas.

Ignacio is an incredibly friendly, flexible and responsive host. It felt like visiting family. Whenever I had to contact him with a question about the flat or the neighbourhood—or simply needed some recommendations about where to find the best places to go out—he responded immediately with great suggestions. Minty, who are administrating the flat, are an extra bonus. The place itself is amazing with a great and clean neighbourhood and lots of options to go for groceries, shopping, a coffee, ice cream or a relaxing walk in the park. Madrid's city centre is also super easily to reach from there. It was a pity the time went by so quickly.

This appartement was amazing! It was extremely clean and the hosts were super friendly and ready to answer all of our questions. The location is perfect because it is next to all the shops and lots of cool bars and restaurants! I would definitely recommend it ;)
Host were very nice and helpful, just as the place itself. Easy check in, clear instructions.
Honestly it was a good experience. We found no trouble getting around and the location was convenient. Very cute place to stay in Madrid.
The place was extremely clean and modern. Isidoro was an excellent host. He was always quick to respond to my messages and provided extremely detailed instructions for the self check in process.
It was great staying at Isidoro’s apartment. He was so helpful with everything. Everywhere was clean and looked exactly like in the pictures. Totally recommend this place!
Perfect apartment to stay in madrid. Really close to everything. The apartment has everything u need to. And Isodoro was really nice and helping during all the way. I recommend 100%
Super location and house is super clean!!!!! And Daniel very kind!! I will come back again!

Great be apartment for short stay! Ideally located - you can get a train or bus from the airport straight to Atocha station in less the 30 mins and the apartment is a 10 min walk. It's also ideally located to see lots of central attractions. There is also a handy supermarket a few doors down. We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely book again when we return to Madrid.

This place is worth every penny, as someone who is a neat freak. Jose's place was spotless. Also, if you are someone who values their privacy, that's what you are going to get; you leave with them, but it feels like you have the apartment all to yourself. They only show up when you need them and ad someone who is not a big talker; I was left alone, but when o feel like talking, they are always there. I would strongly recommend this place if you are short of cash but still need an excellent place to stay.

I had a wonderful 10-day stay at Jose’s place. Jose and his mother were absolutely amazing hosts—so warm, kind, and welcoming. Jose was very helpful throughout my stay and made sure I had everything I needed. The space was comfortable, and I felt completely at home the entire time. I truly appreciated their hospitality and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommend!

Lovely, stylish, and well equipped apartment in a great part of old Madrid. Javier is a great host, was easy to communicate with and couldn’t have been more helpful with both arrival and departure times! Tops my list of great places to stay in Madrid!

This was the first time I had booked and Airbnb so was a little nervous about how it work out. I was meeting a Canadian friend who had done the Camino walk so we both arrived at different times with different modes of travel. Javier could not have been more helpful before, during after our stay. The apartment is well equipped, my friend was able to do all her washing after the walk ! I would not hesitate to recommend this accommodation and I would certainly return.

I loved every inch of this apartment. The apartment is beautiful, me and my partner had a great time. the apartment is very spacious and counts with everything for you to feel like home. Javier is a great hoster. He made my stay in the apartment very smooth and pleasant. If I come back to Madrid, I'll definitely contact Javier.

This was a wonderful place to base our Madrid visit. The place was conveniently located, very clean, well-appointed, and quite charming. It was roomy, and decorated nicely. The master bed was very comfortable. Javier was an excellent host. Lots of restaurants close by as well as a small grocery store. We would highly recommend this place.

Our stay was great! It felt like home. It’s a great place to use to explore the city, cook a few meals, relax, and use as a base to explore day trips to Toledo or other areas. We would absolutely recommend and stay here again when in Madrid!
Great location! Javier was great and helped us with our luggage. He gave us a great run down of what to see and the locations of different restaurants he recommended.
The apartment was turn key furnished including ice, all laundry supplies and meal condiments. Very organized! Lovely seperate spaces inside with individual A/C units. Very comfotable for all.

Our stay in Javier's Airbnb was fantastic! The apartment oozed charm with its exposed beams and hardwood floors. The location was unbeatable - quiet yet just a short walk away from major attractions like the Royal Palace. Javier was incredibly welcoming and helpful, always ready with local tips. This cozy, centrally-located apartment was the ideal base for exploring Madrid’s vibrant culture. Highly recommended!

Javier's apartment is beautiful and interesting. The kitchen is well stocked for cooking and the beds were very comfortable. The neighborhood is lovely. We walked everywhere and enjoyed our stay. Javier was very helpful for check in to check out.

This place was a quiet spot in an otherwise very busy, bustling city. The La Latina neighborhood was hands down the perfect place to stay and come home to this apartment. Appreciated the authentic history and feel of the apartment. Javier is friendly, informative, warm and most importantly very responsive! This is the place to stay in Madrid!

very clean home and quiet neighborhood, friendly and responsive host, great location, it's walkable, and easy access to metro or bus stations. The building has historical significance and therefore does not have an elevator, very useful and considerable amenities like a straightener, and clean dishes
Lovely stay here in a great area! Lots of amazing restaurants and easy to walk just about anywhere.

Our stay was lovely and the apARTment was beautifully designed, very clean and comfortable for our 10 day stay. Monte is an outstanding airbnb host! She is very helpful, caring, kind and responsive. Monte also gave us great info and recommendations. The area is very central and walking distance to many cultural sites, shopping and stores. We highly recommend the Iberian Ham experience with Alberto at the shop his family has owned since 1909 - a 10+++ and the day in the country with Paul and Ian! Our favorite tapas place is Restaurante Cedron which is a nice walk away. All in all a fabulous time!!

This apartment is so nice! A perfect peaceful place to call home for your stay. The neighborhood is very fun to stay in and walking distance to so many great parts of Madrid. Emilio was very helpful with all of our needs and always responded very quickly. Check in and out was a breeze which left us plenty of time to explore the city. Highly recommend!
A quaint stay in the heart of Gran Vía, Emilio’s location had great walkability to everything you will need during your time in Madrid. I highly recommend this location for anyone!

Location, location, location! It was perfect for site seeing and eating well in Madrid. There is an abundance of coffee shops, restaurants, and super markets nearby to make this an awesome home base. The living area was cozy for relaxation or even preparing snacks. The bed was a bit too firm for our liking, but that’s just preference. Highly recommend!

Great apartment, as described; clean, comfortable and well equipped. Location is perfect with lots of bars & restaurants on the doorstep but not noisy inside. Sloping ceiling is quite low on one side of the bedroom, not a big issue but if you are v tall, worth noting! Good there is a lift for the 5th floor!

From the moment we met our host and how warm and friendly he was, to opening the door to our private entrance, to the high-end appliances and furniture, the two balconettes, the tall ceilings, the beauty, THAT walk-in closet, oh and THAT shower head. I NEVER wanted to leave. My husband and decided we would move in if we could. Such a 5-star experience. It was PERFECT. I could stay there a month.

We absolutely loved our stay here! The apartment itself is beautiful, spacious, and clean. The location was spectacular - we explored the area every day and were not short on restaurants to try and plazas to explore. Our hosts were extremely hospitable as well. We would highly recommended to stay here!

Nurias place is one of the best Air Bnbs I have stayed in. We were a family of 4 and it was a big place really comfortable for us. They gave us 2 key sets which was really helpful. everything was spotlessly clean and kitchen was fully stocked. Will highly recommend this place for families.
Very central. Well located to all aspects of Madrid. Secure and safe. Only downside was noise as on street level but common place throughout Madrid.

Great location and good value but it’s better for friends rather than 2 couples as one double bed is in the lounge area and both bathrooms are in this area also instead of en suite. It is quite noisy in Friday and Saturday nights but it’s not to bad on other nights.

Stayed 10+ days while working from home! Very spacious spot for 2! Nice apartment in a fun area of Madrid! I think working from home I would have preferred some more natural sunlight but it wasn’t bad. Thanks and hope to be back in the future

Slept 6 fine. Nice laundry facilities. Street level apartment - noise level was louder than expected. We were given #6 street number, but when waiting at the #6 door we realized we were at the wrong door...directions were unclear. Cleaning lady showed up two hours early so we were rush to check out earlier than expected.

This a really good department, we felt really comfy. The location is awesome, so close to main things to see and close to the metro (the closest is 5 min far). Just the light went off 5 times in 2 days and the partly hot water went off.

Ideal place so close to the airport so I was able to get there for 6am using Uber. Maritza is a kind, lovely host and helped me try to find organic food nearby and gave me help with everything. Would highly recommend

Beautiful location with lots to do within walking distance! Pretty central in the city with a major metro station less than 10 mins walk away. Ramon was very responsive and helpful! Will definitely be staying anytime we’re in Madrid
The apartment is located close to 2 metro stations and it's 5 min bus ride to Atocha rail station.

A cozy apartment in a central part of the city, very close to a metro station and plenty of things to do within walking distance. The host was patient with my broken spanish and provided me a lot of good suggestions on things to do around Madrid.

small renovated cosy flat with very friendly, helpfull owner. Make sure you can cope with souterrain , there is only one small window to open, in the kitchen. it's small but for some few days in Madrid more than enough. the bed was in good shape and hard enough, width less 2m. For me it was quiet enough to sleep, my love was fighting in the night with the voices of the neighborhood. the surrounding is perfect, not too much traffic, but all the bus lines are there. but nearly everything is in walking sight. shops and cafés are just in sight.
Good location, short walk to attractions, also close to the train station. Tidy, and had everything you need.

The host is friendly, check-in process is super easy. The location is very good, interior is nice. It’s clean and you have everything you need (except for maybe a kettle but there’s a small pot). Tall people can find the bed a bit short. There are 2 beds, but it doesn’t help much since they aren’t connected among each other.
We had a fantastic stay in a clean and comfortable apartment. We enjoyed the terrace. The place is in a very nice neighbourhood full of activity. In short: a place to stay when you visit Madrid.

It took us a little while to find the right building when We first arrived but after that everything went smoothly. You could not get a better location, and the Apartment is decorated with a good esthetic eye. The bathroom was practically for the guests only as the host has his own toilet. In the kitchen you find all you need. The is no work desk in the room but I was able to work in the living room those days I had to use My computer. Jesús is a super friendly and relaxed host. I felt like being at home and will for sure return here when coming Back to Madrid!

We were able to book Emilio’s place with short notice (after another listing did not work out). Emilio was very responsive. Everything was as described in the listing. It was convenient having separate rooms and bathrooms. I also enjoyed the design and character of the apartment. Thanks again for allowing us to stay with short notice.
Fantastic stay! The apartment was great and Emilio was very responsive. Will definitely stay again during my next trip to Madrid!

This was one of the best experiences we've had at an Airbnb!!! The host was extremely supportive, very prompt to answer and the house was impeccable! Extremely clean and very warm as there was everything you needed. The house even had an option of dining at home and having a cook make a special meal for you! The view is breathtaking, sunsets and sunrises at the highest building in the area, amazing! The place was very close to everything, walked everywhere, close to the best touristic places and so we didn't need a car. Really worth the pay, reccomend it to everyone that wants a high-end, yet homey pleasant stay at Madrid. Thank you Diego and Odi!

The room is great. Everything is like on the picture. It's great that you have your own bathroom. It's very clean. The hosts are the best, very helpful and communicative. I had great time. High recommendation for this accommodation. 👍

José and Asun, first of all: thank you so much for all the love, attention, fun and hospitality! Staying at Asun and José their house is like staying at your favourite aunt and uncle. They are the most welcoming people I have met, not exaggerating. I felt at home and taken care of. Staying with them is like a warm bath. The room is cosy and comfortable, the bathroom new, stylish and spotless. The neighbourhood is very much madrid, men and women look beautiful, having lunch on every corner of the street. Conclusion: I'm coming back, in the first place for Asun and José. Much love

Thank you José for a great experience staying in your home! You were always kind and helpful from arriving, throughout the stay. The apartment has a perfect location, it's spacious as has all one needs. Room was just great. If you want to meet local people and spend also some time with your hosts, this is the perfect place in Madrid, I highly recommend!
Very good place to stay. has everything you need and more. the shower and the bathroom were spotless and very nice to use. I will definetaly come back
Cristina was very kind and supportive during my stay. The place is lovely and I felt like at home. Definitely I would stay again.
Excellent room with private bath. Cristina has been an excellent host. Valdebebas is a modern district, well connected with parking and all facilities needed.
the only negative aspect of the flat is that the windows are parallel with the street. Fortunately, the outside is cold and I did not need to open the windows frequently
The place is amazing. The bed is super comfortable and the flat is very modern. I’d definitely come back.

We all loved the Airbnb. There were four adults staying and there was plenty of space for eating and relaxing. It was just as described. The location was so convenient. La Latina is loaded with restaurants and places to see, and the Airbnb is right next to the Sam Fransisco cathedral, that is worth the visit. Everything was so walkable and easy, but there were also buses right near by as well as a metro stop. Raul was great at communicating and even helped me book a taxi for my parents departure. We were really happy and hope to book with Raul again in the future.

Great location and great place. The appartement is really big. The place could get a little hot sometimes since there is ceiling fans to cool it off. The neighborhood was super calm. Would stay there again.
The apartment was very nice – spacious, with two separate bedrooms, and very clean. We had a great time, felt comfortable, and we’re satisfied.

Jonathan’s place is great - very clean and new! Location is very central, you can walk all the center of Madrid easily. The Lavapies neighborhood is pleasant with lots of cafes and bars nearby. Overall a great trip and a great stay - thanx Jonathan!

Jonathan’s place was worth what we paid and more. Very nice apartment with oven, microwave, dish washer and clothes washer. Was a 2-5 minute walk from closest transit stop and within 30 minute walk around the entire inner city perimeter. Jonathan was the best host that I have had. He is super responsive and really helps navigate the city l, as well as transporting needs. I appreciated the face to face meeting as well. He really cares.

A wonderful modern place to stay! The location is amazing being able to walk to pretty much every tourist spot Madrid has to offer! Only a 5 minute walk from the subway station so super nice when walking with luggage. The place itself is super big with tall ceilings and very modern. The shower was incredible and HUGE for Europe! Only complaint is directly outside the door there are some sketchy people and we saw a lot of police our first night. We were never bothered but just be high caution, walk 5 minutes down the street and everything felt good. Very responsive host with very good directions and recommendations! He truly cares about his guests
Very responsive and quick. The place is very clean, in a great location that is in the middle of everything; plaza Mayor, port de la Sol, and many more. We loved it and would definitely recommend.

The apartment is beautiful and location is just perfect. The Retiro Park is 2 steps away and location is surrounding by great restaurants, market and bus and metro stops, so it's perfect. Communication with the hosts is very efficient and they are willing to help in every level.

This place was beautiful! Huge windows, modern decor, and most importantly…clean! It was in a great location and walkable to cafes and grocery stores and overall felt like a safe neighborhood. The house has the basics and we only truly spent the night there while spending the rest of the day out and about so can’t speak much on the kitchen utilities, but the house as a whole was worth it. The owners are also very helpful and responsive to any questions you might have before or during your stay! Thank you!
We loved our stay here. It was super clean, comfortable, well-furnished, conveniently located, easy to find, etc. Would definitely stay here again.

Fantastic place in Atosha, Madrid. Very quiet in the apartment and we walked everywhere, although for some the northern areas of the city centre may be a bit far for some. Communication was excellent. Shower was a highlight. Definitely recommend.
Pilar was amazing! She came and met me outside right on time and showed me the parking, the apartment, places to eat and the amazing gym around the corner. very happy 😊

The place is really nice. It does have a clear glass in the living room were light bleeds in at night from the outside the room which we didn't like. The front door wouldn't lock from the inside while we were there. The bathroom door didn't have a lock. If those few things are addressed it's a pretty good place. Location was excellent!

We have had a great stay at Pilar and Dani’s place. The only thing we have to note is that there is not a lot of daylight in the apartment. The rest of the apartment was perfect, would definitely recommend the place.

I stayed here for 3 nights primarily but loved it so much I booked an extra night the host is responsive and the cleaning ladies are so sweet as well as very flexible check in as soon as I got here at 11am my room was ready I would love to return again very soon!
Unbeatable location and beautiful apartment. Host were very responsive and proactive. elevator made everything easier. good air conditioning.

Fantastic location right by the Palace with loads of beautiful cafes and restaurants nearby. The apartment was spacious with two lovely double bedrooms both with large ensuite bathrooms. I would definitely recommend.

very flexible and responsive host, the airBnB is clean and close to the supermarket, a few restaurants and the metro station. We were satisfied with the apartment, only thing you must be aware of is opening all windows when you leave the home in order for the air to circulate through. The air can get a bit stuffy otherwise. Thank you for accommodating us.
Great appartment on the fringes on Sol and the Plaza Square. walking distance to great local spots and restaurants. Would definitely recommend and would stay again if coming back to Madrid.
The place was excellent. Lots of things to do in the area. Host was very helpful and accommodating. Very well located.

This place was great. It was in such a wonderful location, you’re around 20 min to the airport and walking distance to many cafes and restaurants The building has lockers and washing machines Bob and his team thought of everything for the apartment. The Polaroid camera was sooo fun for the kids and so we’re the bunk beds We loved our stay

Esther's place is in a great location, near public transportation, Atocha and Retiro. It is well represented in the description and is good value for money. A good option to spend a few days in Madrid!

This was a great place, My kids and i stayed here for 2 weeks and the host and the apartment were great, they were there for any issues that came up and everything was resolved quickly. I highly recommend you stay her as well. If you want to see all of Madrid while walking everywhere, this is the place to be.
The apartment was really clean, The neighbourhood was quiet, metro station very close. Check in quick and contact with Jorge without any problem. I can recommend this place in Madrid.
This is a very nice apartment (well-laid out, comfortable, and clean) in a popular area near numerous attractions.
Lovely place and very central! Would def recommend this. The lady who cleaned the place was very lovely and helpful :)

Snova's property is extremely well located and a perfect choice when traveling with a group requiring three bedrooms. Despite being located in the heart of the action the noise from outside is barely noticeable. The patio is a very nice option and the electric retractable awning makes it comfortable even in the Summer heat. Note that one cannot drive right up too the building, but it is an easy 2 - 3 min walk from the street and an underground parking garage.

Location, location, location!! Also, really appreciate having a restroom and air conditioning in each room as well. Fernanda was very responsive when we had a minor issue checking in. Would definitely book again when in Madrid.

The place was very clean, thoughtfully designed, and modern. The balcony was a great bonus, providing extra space to relax. Having three bathrooms was especially convenient for our family of five. The host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. There were only two minor inconveniences. First, the check-in process was a bit complicated. Second, the apartment is located within a shopping plaza that locks its gates between 9 PM and 8 AM. On the day of check-out, we were instructed to leave the key in the mailbox, but our e-card did not work at the moment. Thankfully, a local gentleman happened to open the door for us—otherwise, we might have missed our flight. Unfortunately, this detail wasn’t clearly explained in the property description.
Amazing place and great neighborhood the building and appartement are very clean you have everything you might need around. I recommend staying at Alvaro’s place
Great location and responsive host! Great place to stay if you’re going to be just there to sleep - the living room was converted into another bed when we were there.

Had an issue with boiler. Not hot water on arrival. Host messaged me back instantly and had it fixed within the day. Other than that great location and stay. Would recommend to anyone travelling to Madrid. The metro is literally outside the front door

Large flat with a terrace in a very central location in Madrid. Two double beds with comfy mattresses, lounge with TV, large bathroom and basic kitchen. Excellent for a short stay in Madrid. Be aware that you will have to check-in through an external link and upload identification - it was a bit nerve-wracking giving that much information not through Airbnb, but it turned out to be legit and fine. Apparently Madrid requires it - seems unnecessarily intrusive.

A well maintained and modern apartment in Madrid. Communication with the host was quick and clear. A nice bathroom with a big shower. Only two downsides were the lack of dishes (only 4 glasses, 4 plates, 4 spoons etc.), and the two double beds were quite small for 2 adult people. But I can definitely recommend

We had the perfect stay at Julia’s. The location couldn’t be better, just a few minutes’ walk to both the long-distance train station and the local metro. All the major sights are easily accessible by foot, a short bus ride, or a couple of metro stops. The apartment itself is beautiful: clean, bright, spacious, and very comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped, and we had everything we needed for our stay. Supermarkets are close by, and the neighborhood felt safe and convenient. Julia was a lovely and responsive host. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Madrid!
Lovely apartment in a fantastic location. Neighbours were a bit noisy at points but overall fine. Raul was very responsive and we loved our stay. Thank you!
Very nice apartment in a top location in Madrid with all facilities required for a city stay. Raul was really fast in answering and always very nice.
Our Madrid unit was in a perfect location (we walked everywhere). It was clean, secure and easy to get in (we arrived 3:00am)

Good value for the money. The place is spotless and has all ammenities. Not to mention it is in an ideal location. Everything is in walking distace. Perfect for a place to crash, reload and then start exploring again. Raul was available as indicated via Airbnb, the instructions and infos were clear, detailed, exactly what was needed.
Awesome and cozy place, right in the middle of everything. Thank you Raul for everything, we felt at home.

We had a great time at Antonio's place. The appartment is comfortable, so are the beds! The kitchen is modern and well equipped. the metro station is super close, and the appartment is walling distance from Retiro Park. There is a restaurant downstairs in which people watch football games...it can get noisy in the evenings but not late at night. Even knowing this, I would gladly go back to this appartment!
Alex’a place was as described and seen on photos. The unit was very nice and clean. I would stay there again! Host was very communicative and responsive at all times.

I stayed at this accommodation and here's my review: The interior is beautifully decorated, and the three entrance doors provide a sense of security. However, there are a few drawbacks: no kettle in the Apartment, no shampoo or body wash provided, and finding a parking space was very challenging.

The area was amazing, right in the heart of Madrid. I would also say that the room looked better in reality than in photos and it was clean. We also had free snacks which was really nice! Overall, a great experience :)

The room matched the description perfectly. It wasn't noisy at all, in fact I had no trouble catching sleep. The main attractions of Madrid's city center are all a few minutes away, but in spite of this the area is quite and safe by night. There are free coffee and snacks, which were very much appreciated. Definitely recommended.

Lovely apartment in a convenient location. Close to metro and walking distance to many attractions. Apartment was clean and spacious with plenty of storage space and fully equipped kitchen. Quiet building and apartment with outdoor space. Apartment was exactly as described. Host was responsive and helpful both accommodating our timing and with helpful tips. Would stay again!
Thank you very much ! Very nice place with a touch of design and very well located in Madrid ! I truly recommend Julia’s place

Had a really lovely stay at Julia’s in Madrid! A beautiful apartment in a great location, really walkable and lots of great spots nearly. Julia was really responsive, we will definitely be back next time we are in Madrid! Thanks 🤍

We absolutely loved our stay here! In a beautiful location just a short walk from loads of attractions. It was super easy to locate from the airport (just a 30 minute metro journey) and was a great airbnb that served us well! One of the more equipped airbnbs I’ve been in before (lots of kitchen appliances and spare towels, etc).
Great stay at Julia's beautiful and amazingly located flat. In one of the most lively and animated parts of Madrid yet on a quiet street.

This was our first Airbnb and I have to say we was very impressed with the whole service. Julie's apartment is lovely, well equipped and spotlessly clean. The location is amazing under 5 minutes from the metro station and local restaurants and shops. Happily stay again.
Julia is super nice and very helpful. The that is exactly like the picture and quite near to metro station. Totally recommend

Montaber's cozy apartment is nestled between Madrid's famous Velazquez and Serrano streets. It's a posh quarter with plenty of restaurants, shops, and beautiful buildings. The location is irreprochable and couldn't be better. The flat itself is also great. It has all the amenities you might need for a short, or long stay. Three of us stayed there and it never felt too too small or cluttered. The host provided clear instructions on how to get there and wa just on time for our check in. I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking for a quiet holiday in Madrid, away from the bustle of the center at night, but also just 20 minutes on foot away from just about anywhere you'd want to be. From Sol and the Plaza Mayor, to Retiro which is just 15 minutes walking away.

María was very friendly and responded quickly to whatever I asked her while I stayed there. The flat is located in the heart of Madrid. You can go to any attractions ns on, foot. There was everything that we wanted; shampoo, conditioner, hair dryer, air conditioning, utensils, etc. Additionally, I was so happy that there was a lift! I highly recommend this place, thank you for all your help! Gracias ☺️

Check-in was easy and convenient for our needs and the apartment was very nice and clean with all the amenities we required. I would recommend people to stay here and would come back again if I'm in Madrid.

Great communication with the host. Very helpful in showing the apartment and helpful in suggesting the tourist spots. The apartment was also very clean, comfortable and located in a very nice neighbourhood, with easy bus and metro access. The apartment is also located on ground floor which makes it very convenient.

I was so happy with the apartment. Great location, spotless bathroom & kitchen, very comfortable bed. Just like any other comments, the apartment being on the ground floor and looking at the main road does make it a bit loud at night, but apart from this I didn’t have any issues. Would definitely recommend!
Carlos and Maria are great hosts! The apartment was well appointed and very clean. Location was good and close to beautiful parks.

My stay here was amazing. The picture didn't match the unit I stayed in but it had all the amenities I was expecting. It was a quite neighborhood and was safe to walk at night. It's also 5 mins walk from the public transit, and close to a grocery store. I'm really happy that I stayed here on my work trip. Thank you for hosting me, Jacinto.
Great flat! Newly renovated and in the back of the building so not noisy. I really enjoyed my stay and would be back here again!
Good location, feels like everything is up to 30 minutes walk. The place as described and has all you need.

The place is centrally located within a walking distance to Gran Via, it's clean and good enough for couples spending most of their time outside. The only problem is that being located at the 4th floor which might be cumbersome at times especially if you have big luggage or returning late at night after long day of walking. apart from that, all is well.

Such a a great little set up. Spacious room and bathroom. had everything we needed for our stay in Madrid, did use the social area but kitted out with everything you need. Great location and beautiful views.

Location, location, location! If you're looking for a place just off the Gran Via in Madrid, but quite calm (and silent in the bedrooms, which overlook an interior courtyard, not the street, then this is it. The place is clean , spacious and comfortable with air conditioning that can be adjusted in three zone (living room/kitchen and the two bedrooms). All interactions with the Pantala team were rapid and helpful.

Amazing stay and is located perfectly in the middle of everything! There are so many things to do within 10 minutes of walking. Amazing hosts who were very responsive! Being from the South (USA), they showed amazing hospitality!

Amazing place in the heart of Madrid Center. Walking distance to Gran Via, shops, restaurants and Metro stations. Highly recommended for families/groups of 5-6. Place is very spacious, incredibly quiet and easy to access. Will definitely look for it when coming back to Madrid. Felipe is the most responsive host I´ve ever had in AirBnB. I left the keys in and got his support all the way.

Everything was great. Location is right across a metro station, very easy to get around. Only things to keep in mind when booking: Master bathroom has clear window to the living area. Basement room and bathroom smell humid.
The Apartment was nice in a very good location. The host was always available and very friendly. The Bathroom was not very clean and neither the bedsheets. But anyway functional and acceptable.
