Rafael was a great host. The location was perfect. I wish it was a bit more modern. I do know that he addressed the air conditioning issue without me even mentioning it to him to he is very proactive.

Cozy and well situated, surrounded by restaurants and Coffee shops, walking distance to park and major transportation hubs. Tucked away from main the street offering peace and quiet. Unfortunately, the place needs a major facelift and a better cleaning crew. We found multiple hair strands on the bed sheets, pillows, in the shower and bathroom sink. We winded up having to buy a new sheets, pillow covers and towels before sleeping in. The floor seemed to have been cleaned but hard to tell whether its stickiness was due to quality of the cleaning product used. One cannot miss the multiple dark stains on the couch, a simple throw on would have made us overlook the couch’s shabby state. adequate supply of toilet paper or single use water bottle were not provided. Host seams to be on the stingy side.
Very smooth and easy stay. Oscar’s made sure I had everything I needed. Wonderful host, and wonderful stay!
Our favorite part of the space was the location, it had walkable access to all the areas we wanted to see yet removed from busy city streets. Would stay here again!

Lovely neighborhood and really easy and friendly communication with the booking team. The place was a little smaller than we expected and unfortunately a bit noisier than we thought as located just above a bar. Overall this was a good apartment for a one night stay :)
The place was very clean but tiny, it was safe but noisy during the night, the breakfast was perfect. Thank you very much .

Good value, nice and communicative host. Good location, there were a couple of imperfect things like the AC motor leaking water but it’s as described. Not much space for a living room but it was perfect to sleep in when visiting the city

Excellent host who responded to our requests in a timely manner with fantastic local recommendations for dining! The location of the apartment is amazing, literally on the Plaza Mayor. It was surprisingly quiet given its location. Host was flexible and allowed us to leave our luggage at the apartment early before check in on the day we arrived from out of the country, which was much appreciated. There is not a lot of common or shared space in the apartment other than a small area with a tv and 2 person couch — but that was not an issue for us since we were always out seeing the city when not sleeping. I would stay here again without hesitation and the price was a good value. Muchas Gracias!

Great location in the heart of Plaza Mayor. Easy walking access to restaurants and sites. It is a compact home yet provides space to spread out w three bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. Clean place which is of upmost importance. Enjoyed our stay.

This is an amazing apartment for those wanting to go to Madrid. Everything from the check-in to the checkout, everything was painless. The location of the apartment is awesome! It’s close to everything and the location was awesome! Anyone going to Madrid, I’d highly recommend this apartment to make you feel at home. Begoña was super helpful and very kind. Overall, great deal.
Very convenient location, right on Plaza Mayor. our booking was last minute and the host was very responsive when we arranged for check in
We were 6. Great place we loved it. The room near the street a bit noisy but all in all is great. Easy to access by public transport, a lot of bars and restaurant in walkable distance. 5 star.

My son and I had a nice stay at this apartment near Sol. It was very easy for us to get around on public transportation and there were lots of food options nearby. It was easy to keep the space a comfortable temperature. There is a large refrigerator and a washing machine and drying rack. There was some construction going on in the building but the workers were nice and generally the noise was not a problem during sleeping hours. The apartment has everything you will need!
We were here for the weekend and it was all you need for a short stay. Our airbnb got cancelled and we booked this one very last minute and had no problem. Thank you!!
Roy’s place was clean and as described. Close to train station and bus terminal so easy for transportation into city or elsewhere. Would recommend.

Perfect location. Beautiful space. And Anette was a wonderful host with lots of lovely, thoughtful touches — water, beer, coffee, a helpful list of recommendations — in the apartment. I’d stay here again.

Fell in love with this small, but very comfortable apartment, felt ourselves right as at home LaLatina is a perfect neighborhood you can reach all the Madrid landmarks by walking for 10-20 minutes Annetes instructions and apartments photos was very helpful for restaurants selection and especially for “Lock&befree”luggage storing service Would definitely stay there again in our next Madrid visit

Annette is very sweet and responsive. The apartment is small but we were out most of the time so it was fine. Really good location to the Metro so it was easy to get to everywhere. The heating was very good. I would stay again.
Very cute place! Small but well appointed. Comfortable bed. Neighborhood was very interesting. Annette was very charming and helpful.

Annette was super responsive and clear with communicating throughout the entire process. The apartment was really well located next to the metro and we were able to walk to everywhere in the city from our home base. The apartment was nice and quiet, perfect to recharge the batteries for the next days adventure. Would 100% come back and stay again.

Maribel and Carlos were excellent hosts. They were very communicative and easy to get in touch with, and the place was very comfortable. It’s a nice, quiet neighborhood that’s very proximate to a lot of good restaurants and things to do. Would definitely recommend!
Great place and responsive host. The views are immaculate and the place was very clean upon arrival. Metro is almost next door and it is in a centric location.

Jorge’s apartment is a great location and has great amenities! It was a very comfortable stay for two, and it allowed us to work from home very comfortably as well. The location is in Gran Via, close to MANY restaurants and shops and with a couple metro stops as well. Great experience!
Everything was perfect! The appartement was clean and very cozy. Mr. Takanivi was very helpful and responded quickly. The place is very well equipped. It was an excellent stay!
Great location and place. Communication and check in without any problem. Only issue is the mould in the bedroom and bathroom.
A very nice spotless apartment, well located and fairly easy to find. Once you get the hang of the app to open the doors, it’s a lovely place to stay.

Stunning apartment and excellent location. Very peaceful but also right in the centre with loads of bars and restaurants. Absolutely spotless and has everything you’d need. Good communication. Would highly recommend this place.
This is our second time staying here. The view is spectacular and the accommodations pristine and modern. Susa was in contact with us 24/7 and was very helpful. A+

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Madrid. The unit was very clean, comfortable, and quiet. The apartment has a beautiful view of the city! The location was great as it was close to the major sites and had easy access to public transportation. The owner was very communicative and accommodating. Thank you for a very enjoyable stay.

We had a great stay at Maria’s. The view was amazing. We were very close to the Malasaña neighborhood while being outside the noise. The apartment was very clean and the bed was comfortable. The highlight for us was the water pressure in the shower. I was able to work full time with no wifi issues. We would definitely stay again and would recommend the apartment.

The place is perfect for a family or a group of friends. If you have a baby, make sure to specify you want a crib and pay that extra fee or otherwise you won’t get the mattress, but they were nice enough about it
In the heart of the La Latina but in the quiet street which makes apartment very cozy and lovely for the families. Very clean and equipped with all you need for the long stay.
Beautiful spacious apartment, well equipped with everything you need for a longer stay. Location is perfect, close to the metro and city center. We had a great stay.
We had a fantastic stay great apartment lively neighbourhood lots to do first time in Madrid and will definitely visit again.

A very comfortable home within walking distance to Plaza Mayor and to metro services with plenty of nice restaurants and bars in the vicinity. Marta and Enrique were very responsive and the check in and check out instructions were easy to follow. An ideal place to stay for a city break in Madrid.

The apartment is comfortable, clean and well equipped. Anaisabel was friendly and helpful, and very responsive to our questions. The location is safe, central - brilliant, with easy access to the metro, directly above a great little supermarket, and a nice walk (or run!) to Retiro park. And the pool - it is a real treasure, especially in the height of the Madrid summer! Muchas gracias!
This was the best I've stayed in. A beautiful apartment. Convenient for everything. Madrid is special, as were our hosts. Thank you so much. We shall return. x

We loved our stay in this apartment for our three days in Madrid. Alan was super helpful and met us as we pulled in. He helped us figure out the best way to get there from the airport (Madrid taxis are awesome and easy). Apartment was just what we wanted and needed. Peaceful and relaxing. A great place to come back to after walking around the city all day. The area near Lava Pies was perfect for us. Older part of town and full of life but still chill. Would stay here again on our next trip back to Madrid. So mid to enjoy

The apartment is in an excellent location - you immediately exit onto one of the busiest streets in Madrid. At the same time, the apartment itself is very quiet. The downside is that it is an attic with a very low ceiling. You can stand up to your full height only in the very center of the room. You have to be very careful because there is a high chance of hitting your head on a wooden beam. The drain in the shower stall is faulty - when using the sink, the water begins to rise with a very unpleasant odor. I hope this problem can be resolved.

Apt as described, in a great location. Host even let us check in early. Would have been nice to have some basic kitchen necessities - hand soap, hand towel, dish soap, paper towels, nespresso pods for coffeemaker. Also, host met us upon arrival and we had to sign additional contract along with passport verification upon arrival. Have not experienced that before in an Air BNB. Overall, good stay, but annoyed at having to buy the above kitchen necessities for a short stay.
They were very accommodating and had a beautiful and clean place. I loved staying here and enjoying the views from the balcony. I would definitely recommend this place for others.

Well equipped apartment with new furniture TV and kitchen machines situated in an very quiet central area. Maria is a very responsive host, ready to answer questions and giving valuable advices in no time. I strongly recommend this apartment for short or long term accommodations in Madrid.
A comfortable little apartment in an excellent location! The apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Definitely recommend to anyone travelling to Madrid! 😊

We enjoyed our time in Madrid and loved our stay at Monaro Apartments. It was perfect for what we had planned. Its location is great because it’s near restaurants, stores, within walking distance of the train station, and close to everything you’ll need for your trip. I stayed with my parents, who are 65, and it was also good for them. The apartment was comfortable for the three of us. The only thing I would change is the check-in time (even though you can check in earlier for an additional fee) because many people take overnight flights and arrive early in the morning. But other than that, we loved it. Thank you so much!
Smaller than expected but a great place right in the middle of the city Will book again
Everything was just perfect! Location is great, walkable, lots of great restaurants around. Helpful and responsive hosts. Hoping to be back!

We had a fantastic stay with Mayra and her wonderful family! They were incredibly welcoming, and the room was exactly as described. Very comfortable in a peaceful corner of Madrid. We look forward to coming back!

David’s place was great. It’s very central to everything. Perfect for the 3 of us. It’s cosy. The only thing is that it’s the 6th floor. It doesn’t get easier, but on the plus size I got all my daily steps in lol 😂

We had a lovely stay! The apartment is located in a beautiful and very central area, which made it easy to explore the city. Everything we needed was nearby. The place was comfortable and just as described. Overall, highly recommended!

Apparently a brand new and modern apartment, equipped with everything you need. Centrally located in the city, a short distance from the beautiful Retiro Park. Within walking distance of a number of Madrid's attractions. Quiet place (mid-town). Shops, bakeries, bars, and eateries in the surrounding area
We enjoyed our st y in Juan José s place, the location is perfect, easy and safe to walk around in the park night. The apartment is nice, super well equipped, and very clean.

We loved our stay at the apartment. We were in Madrid during a crazy summer heat wave. The apartment stayed cool and comfortable the whole time due to the radiant floor cooling system, which we loved. The location is beautiful. It is in a more upscale neighborhood with wonderful places to eat, walk, and shop and very close to Subway. The apartment beds were so comfortable. I had the best sleep there! We absolutely loved the design and flow of the space. Very modern and very comfortable! Loved coming back to the apartment after sightseeing. We hope to return again.

Our experience at the flat was wonderful, the house has excellent conditions and a cozy decoration. It has the necessary utensils if you need to cook something, a practical washer/dryer, and two separate bathrooms. Its location is fantastic, a few meters from the Prosperidad metro station, bus stops, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, in short, everything you could need just a few steps away. The host of the apartment was always available when we needed her, very friendly and helpful. If you are planning a trip to Madrid, this is definitely an excellent option for your accommodation.

We had a lovely stay , the place was very clean and did meet my all my needs, the neighborhood is very cool. Helena was very nice and answers all our doubts. We will return to this place, very soon Thank you Enrique your place in very nice.

A perfect place to stay in the heart of Madrid! Very walkable to all attractions and shops. Everything you need and/or want in Madrid is within a 15 minute walk! Construction right out the windows was a tad noisy, but overall for being in the heart of a city the noise was very minimal! Would definitely recommend, please keep in mind you have to go up lots of stairs.

Great space, very, very easy to walk to the main sites and great for local restaurants, bars, tapas!! We really appreciated the location! Room was great, bed firm, building and area quiet! Even though it was close to everything. The room air conditioning was an added bonus!!! We really enjoyed our time at Attiq’s place!!
A lovely stay at Gestion’s apartment! The place is so chic & beautifully decorated, and walking distance to everything you need. Would happily come again
This was a great stay! The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a 2-night stay. The location was great- walking distance to many spots and close to the metro. Glad we found this spot!
The Airbnb was perfect. Everything was in walking distance. It was clean and included all the necessary amenities. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The listing is within walking distance of many local restaurants and shops. It's not a very touristy part of town, which made it perfect for us. If you want the tourist attractions, it is within a couple minutes walk of a metro station. Unit was clean and comfy. Beds were perfectly soft. Thanks so much for a great stay and perfect place from which to explore Madrid!

We had a fantastic long weekend at Eliana’s place. The location is amazing, next to Chueca and Salamanca in an apartment with amazing views. Fully stocked kitchen and a nice big bathroom. Eliana was incredible, very responsive and helpful. The check-in was easy although we got in very late. Highly recommended. Thank you Eliana for an amazing stay!
Great location. Central to everything. Size of the place is huge. Great stay.

Great accommodation for our family of 3. We loved this central location right opposite to the Mercado De San Miguel and the Mayor Plaza. Very convenient to hang out, get good food or see a show around town. There is a Starbucks adjacent to the building and they open at 8am! Home has all essential amenities including a washer-dryer. We would definitely be back here next November.
Apartment is clean and modern, nicely decorated, great bathroom. The location is as central as you can be, which also means the street can be a bit loud at night. Overall a great stay. Thanks!
This Airbnb was perfect for us! It is very very central, next to Plaza Mayor and we loved the San Miguel Mercado. Very chic apartment!

We loved staying at Marta and Arturo’s place. The instruction were very clear and made the process smoother. They were very friendly and even provided us with local recommendations. Definitely recommend!
Great location, near the tube and walkable distance to SOL. Decoration wonderful as well, 10/10.

It's a beautiful space in a great location. Mind you, it's not a private apartment; it's built for hosting guests. Thus, it feels like a hotel room, and its tiny kitchenette that neatly hides behind closet doors only emphasises that feeling. That being said, it's immaculately made, very cosy, stylish, squeaky clean, and ideally located on a quiet street, almost hidden in the middle of a busy district, 5 minutes away from the King's palace and an abundance of restaurants. The host is helpful, professional and responsive. I would definitely book again.
Clean,cozy well furnished place. Bed was super comfy and the modern shower I liked a lot as well. absolutely to recommend!
Beautiful modern and comfortable condo in the heart of Madrid with gorgeous views from the 16th floor windows. Comfortably sleeps four! We would come back anytime to this beautiful apartment.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Susana was very responsive and even set up a taxi to pick us up from the airport. Highly recommend!

Great accommodation near Santiago Bernabeu. Easy and clear instructions for room access were provided the day before arrival. The room and shared areas were very clean. The host was friendly and readily available via text message. Restaurants, amenities, and public transport to the city centre are all within walking distance. The neighbours were respectful, though the room's sound insulation could be improved. However, this was not a major issue for a short stay, and I would definitely come back again.

Ricardo's apartment is in a great location. We enjoyed our stay there. Everything needed to get us started was there, such as coffee pods, bathroom soap, even a washer and clothes line. Ricardo was very accommodating and helpful in every way.

The apartment is very well located, walking distance to museums, interesting places, restaurants and shopping. It is well fitted with all a tourist would need. Ricardo communicates very easy and fast and he is flexible as much as possible regarding checking in and out.

Great value for your money, well designed, safe neighborhood with different shopping options, coffee places, grocery stores and local restaurants. Easy Uber pick up location footsteps of the apt or you can choose to take a nice walk to el Retiro park . The place is located on the 5th Floor no views but lots of windows and natural light that comes in. Beds are comfortable I will only suggest to get softer pillows. The inside of the apt has modern and comfortable furniture which created a great vibe to hang out and rest.

The owner and housekeepers responded promptly and enthusiastically. I was very happy to stay in this room. The room was clean, quiet and comfortable, perfectly in line with the description, and even bigger than it looked in the photo.Will def live again. 100% recommend!
Great apartment, excellent host. If I was back in Madrid, I’d be happy to stay at this place every day of the week and twice on Sunday.

Pablo’s place was cozy, clean,quiet and there are many stores nearby to get necessities. Pablo was also very helpful and communicative asking if everything was to our liking. Everything happened as agreed upon, and we will definitely be coming back. Fast and stable internet connection. Highly recommend.

Great modern place outside the downtown. Has good transportation - bus, metro, renfe, 2 stations from the airport. Loft is modern, ideal for a couple, theoretically + kid on the couch. Host Fernando is easy to reach via phone, very helpful in case of issues. Important: when you google the address, there are two locations - the correct one, close to transport, and the wrong one, 2km away. Don’t make my mistake… :)
Everything was great! Luis was very responsive and helpful with any questions. The location is also great- right in the middle of a lot or restaurants and stores.

A fun, and eclectic place to stay. The only drawback was that both bathrooms were upstairs. The apartment was clean and had everything you needed for a good stay. Luis was responsive and was a good host making sure we had accurate descriptions of what to do once we got there. I would recommend staying there just knowing that the apartment layout is a little funky.

We arrived late in the evening, it was raining heavily and there was a storm. We were in contact all the time with Fran and Isabelle, who provided us with quick access to the apartment. Everything was clean and nice. Thanks for the helpful guide!
Clean appt. Lots of space for my family of 5 Nice art Has the right kitchen stuff but not cluttered. Would definitely stay there again
Really good place,fairly new but everything was almost perfect. Thank you Doris for being a nice host.
Upstairs smelled of sewage. Host didn’t offer refund. A few guests bought hotels and some slept on the couch.
Awesome apartment. Perfect location. Simple check in. Host was really kind to let us check out late as my girlfriend was really sick. Muchas gracias 🙏
Centrally located and practical apartment close to the metro, with a responsive and communicative host.

We really enjoyed our stay at this centrally-located apartment! Great location with easy walking to museums, etc. it was great having two separate bedrooms, each with their own private bath. And the king-size mattress in the larger bedroom was super comfortable! A little bit dusty, but overall in good condition.
It was a pleasant place. it has fulfilled all our expectations. We definitely recommend it.
The shower was cold sometimes. Check in was not flexibel. But was very good. We enjoy and recomend.

This is a lovely apartment is a great area of Madrid. It is very close to metro lines with several grocery stores nearby. There is a wonderful local resturant next door that does great breakfasts as well as wine in the evening. Marta is great with commincation and always willing to help.
The place was okay, although the photos that are listed make the apartment seem twice as big as it is in reality.
Raul's home was clean and convenient. The apartment was accessible and walkable to many local places.
Great place to stay at, very peaceful and close to city center, a lot of things to do around and great hosts!

This is my second time staying here, and it is a great place to live—spacious apartments! Only the detergents are lacking. There were not enough for the entire stay, and there was only dishwashing detergent once.

Apartment was as described. The windows don’t really let any light in but we knew that when we booked so it wasn’t a surprise. It was a good value place to stay for the location and size. There was a slight drain smell in the kitchen.
Loved every bit of it. It was clean and proper. The check in was super smooth as well.

I had a great stay and was very happy with my trip. It was in the heart of Madrid near supermarkets and Madrid life. The apartment was very modern and clean and smelt good. The size was perfect and would definitely recommend it to friends. Finding information in Numa was very effective and easy to get in touch.
J place is a great to relax and enjoy the area around his place, there are restaurants, supermarkets, coffee shops, fruits shops that you can get anytime thanks so much for everything…

Excellent apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. It has everything you need for a short or a long stay. There is a supermarket next door. Easy and quick to get to the center using the metro. Fran and Isabel are great hosts.

We had a good stay. The room is clean and convenient to shops and public transportation. The bed is pretty small for two people, and it's really not comfy. The communication with the host was a bit weird at first, but it was still good overall.
Great apartment, very well located in Chamberi. Particularly liked that there was a working space and spacious living room and kitchen.
This is spacious apartment in a lovely walkable neighborhood. Metro lines are nearby to explore Madrid. Definitely would recommend.

I had a great stay at Jose Maria's place. It was clean, cozy, and well kept. The location was a great spot in La Chueca with plenty of restaurants and shops within close walking distance. I would not hesitate to stay there again.

Absolutely perfect place to stay for the price it’s listed. The location is great and so many things are walking distance. We stayed in July when it was very hot but there was a nice fan that helped so much. Would recommend!
Nice apartment very well located. All perfect except the AC which was not really functioning. The owner will take care and fix it. But not so warm for our stay so not a big problem.

The apartment is located in a lovely area, it's well equipped with everything you need and very clean. The windows work great against noise from outside, but you definitely hear the neighbors (also Airbnb) from above quite a lot.

This was a very nice surprise. The apartment was in a perfect location, extremely clean and quiet. Everything in the place worked well. AC was cold and nice and the bedrooms also have ceiling fan, which was appreciate it for the hot Madrid’s weather in this summer. Hosts were helpful and responsive and always in touch. We would definitely try to book again in our next trip!

Gustavo is an amazing host - very prompt response and accommodating. One of the best hosts I've experienced within any of the Airbnb properties we've stayed at. Thank you for a wonderful stay, Gustavo!

It’s a peaceful neighborhood, where you can find all kind of services, and near public transportation and more lively neighborhoods without the noise. The host attended very soon a detail on the bathroom. Everything was ok.

It is a cozy unit that fits 2 person exactly. The distance to the Mercadona is just 2 mins walk away and there is 2 different Metro stops that is 3-5 mins walk. The neighbourhood is nice as it is not really central located but it will be quiet and good place to sleep in during the night. :)
Great stay at Javi’s place, he was very proactive with communication. Being a bigger group the space fit for our needs perfectly. Gracias Javi!
Very nice place, very well located, close to everything. I recommend this place 10000%

Airbnb was the perfect amount of space for the 5 of us. Three large bedrooms and two really nice bathrooms were great. Kitchen had everything we needed including a nice big table for eating. There was also an area with a couch and chair (with tv) for extra seating. Location was great, close to restaurants, grocery stores and metro. Communication with host was easy and he was very responsive. Would highly recommend staying here.

The accommodation absolutely met our expectations. The coordination was smooth and easy. The very central location is an ideal base for exploring Madrid. Thank you for hosting us. We would book the accommodation again!
It is a nice place close to public transport.there are markets nearby. Clean and nice place with all kitchen stuff. I enjoyed
Great loft, small but you have everything you need for your holidays, it is not too far from the Gran Via, the metro station is at 7 minutes walk

The apartment was jut like on the pictures , and the balcony was a big plus. It was really clean, the bed was comfortable. Carlos responded to our messages really quickly. I would recommend this to others. It was really easy to access from the city. Had a lot of shops nearby. The area was surprisingly quiet.
Good location a little further from the centre, but handy for 3 metro stations. As described with nice sunny outside area. lots of shops and places to eat within 10 min walk.
Good location, clean home! Host is always responsive. I only spent a night sleeping but I had a good night sleep… thank you! Gracias ❤️

The flat was very clean, with a good air conditioning system and well equipped with everything we needed. The view was nice, and the location was great — everything was within a 10-minute walk. Overall, a very comfortable stay!
Luis' place was perfect for my two day stay in NYC. Luis was extremely helpful and the stay was perfect. Location is perfect and the little balcony was great. Highly highly recommend!

Very clean and seems recently updated. Only just very sparse on towels, no paper towels or top sheet in the beds. The neighborhood is a bit rougher also, but safe enough if you know how to keep your wits about you. Only 10 min walk to the metro Nueva Numancia on the 1 line. Good local fruit and veg markets. I would stay again!

great place and great location! Alejandra, the hostess, was always attentive and responsive, no issues at all. we will def stay here again next time we are in Madrid. location is great, easy to get on Metro and go anywhere including to the airport!
Nice apartment with an extremely good location for staying in Madrid. Amir was quick to respond whenever we had a question or issue. Would happily stay again.
Flat was just as described. Everything was clean and the kitchen was well equipped with the basics for cooking and making coffee I can highly recommend this apartment and would book again!
Everything about the unit and neighborhood was spot on. Unfortunately the last evening wifi was dropping. Javier though was very responsive and troubleshooted the cause. Overall a good stay.

Good as a base in Madrid, well connected by metro and a park nearby. The flat is modern, well equipped and has self controlled heating for the colder nights. I liked the keyless entry system and although there were some problems with the main entrance of the building, these were fixed promptly. The host is professional and has an always available helpline that works very well. Instructions and communication are clear and helpful.

Enrique and Javier were phenomenal! They helped me with some dumb questions, answered very quickly, and were very kind through it all. One thing I will add, too, is the hot water would run out around ten to fifteen minutes in the shower. For just myself, that was fine. For groups larger than one, expect shorter showers! Otherwise, fantastic spot to visit!!

Loved staying at Gian’s, everything was perfect. The place looked great and had lots of services, and an amazing shower. The area as well is great and with lots of restaurants around and a 24/7 Carrefour. Walkable distance from the center, although uphill (like everything in Madrid hahahaha). Gian is a great person and very friendly, he let me stay a bit after the check-out to wait for my brother who had to arrive. 10/10 experience.

Amazing stay. The apartment is perfectly located for shopping, dining, nightlife and getting around the city. Ben was a very kind and attentive host. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and return for our next stay.
Excellent host and location. Exactly as described. Perfect for our family. Beds were not super comfortable but fine for our 3 night stay. Happy to have stayed at this apartment!

Laura and her family were exceptional hosts who were kind and extremely accommodating. The unit is simply better and larger than photos can capture. The accumulation of detail and beauty in the unique design leaves a stunning impression. It is unlike anything I have ever stayed in. I have already recommended it to many friends. Location is central but peaceful with coffee shops and more just around the corner.
This place is good for what it is. The fire alarm went off 3 times during our sleep and that was annoying! Overall, not bad for a night

If you’re looking for a place to rest your head while you explore Madrid this place will definitely do the trick. The host is very responsive and kind. The place is in need of a little maintenance but nothing serious. But overall it was a good experience.

Great stay. Loved this new apartment. It was very clean, with everything needed. Great access to metro and busses. Walkable too. Access to great supermarkets. Great host that communicates well and punctually.

It was very nice stay. Daniel was always helpful, even let us stayed 1 hour longer, since we needed it. You got a lot of good bars, pubs and restauratns with very attractive prices. Metro is close by with good connections, also markets, and little shops are just around the corner. Very nice stay for that price, perfect for city break.
Very nice room, very good towels and bed sheets, it’s like a hotel but very comfortable for 1 or 2 people

I enjoyed my stay and was very happy with how clean everything was! it was cozy and felt right at home. Host was super commutative and proactive and answers almost immediately so you be in good hands!

I stayed at Angelica's for just a night but it well worth as I gained a friend! Yes, that is how good she was at conversing and making me feel right at home from the very start! The place was absolutely spot on in terms of the location, access and comfort; and additionally the kindness that she had to keep my luggage over and beyond my checkout time plus the enthusiasm with which she loved my art and love for music and food with her recommendations were fabulous! Will definitely stay again when visiting Madrid!
This is a great to the point Airbnb we only stayed two days between flight and it worked out for us being near the airport. We actually walked there was an under 30 min walk.
Big thanks to Carmen for organizing such an easy way to get to the flat. Very cozy place, the perfect location. Perfect for 2 people to stay in Madrid. Definitely will come back
Raul is very responsive and was a great host! The flat itself is located very close to the train station and about a 15-25 minute walk to most all of the tourist spots.
Very nice Airbnb. Despite there being no Wi-Fi and no Masmovil signal, I still recommend it
